label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder01
text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, we're all that's left of the assault force! We need to build a Command Center and get the radar up to receive new orders'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder02
text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, if we don't get our radar up we can't receive intelligence on the enemy's position. We need that radar'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder03
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, you're alive!?! We thought we lost you when the bridge went down. Well, you're not out of danger yet, so let's get started'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder04
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'First, you're going to need to finish your base. The barracks, reactor, and supply center are all essential to your survival, so finish constructing them immediately. I'll contact you again once your base is complete'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder05
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, your base is complete, except for a War Factory. We need to get you one now. There should be a surplus base--with a War Factory--here'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder06
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'I don't know what condition the base is in, but it should allow you to build armored units to help your fight. Get there as soon as possible, General.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder07
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Now we know the GLA's reason for coming to Hong Kong: They're targeting key buildings around the city. Our main objective is to destroy all of the GLA's forces, but if we can also keep them from destroying those buildings, our leaders would be most grateful.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder08
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'If you can keep your radar operating, I can track the Terrorists for you and give you their possible targets.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder09
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, a Terrorist is leaving the Convention Center, and he's strapped with enough explosives to bring down a building! I'll mark the Terrorist in red on your radar. I'll mark his possible targets in yellow. Stop him before he reaches one of those targets!'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder10
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Another Terrorist has left the Convention Center! I'll mark his location in red. His possible targets are marked in yellow. Stop him, General.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder11
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, this building is a Terrorist target--we must protect it!'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder12
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the Terrorists have taken over the Convention Center! You're going to have to destroy the Convention Center and the attached parking structures to stop the Terrorist threat.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder13
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, you've reached the surplus base. Hmm, it's not much to look at, but it will allow you to build tanks, and more War Factories, if you need.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder14
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'The Terrorist threat is finished. Good work, General.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder15
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, I've detected GLA armored units on the move. They didn't come from the Convention Center, so the GLA must have another base somewhere in Hong Kong. Find that base and destroy it!'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder16
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the GLA have brought their Toxin Tractors with them. You'll know them by the green ooze they spray. Keep your infantry units away from them and use your tanks to deal with this new threat.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder17
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Good work, General, you've destroyed the Toxin base. Now they shouldn't be able to build any more Toxin Tractors.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder18
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Wait, General, there is a large force up ahead. I'll call for an EMP strike to clear the area, standby.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder19
text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'That should give you a clear path to their base. Let's finish this, General.'

label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder20
text:
<AutoFerry Capt. speaking> 
 'Finally, the military is here! Those Terrorists are ruining my business! If you put your forces aboard I'll take you out to the Convention Center. You can sneak in the backdoor and catch them by surprise. Jut hit the Transport button when you're ready.'

label: SCRIPT:TrainingUnits

label: SCRIPT:TrainingPower

label: SCRIPT:TrainingAbilities

In the case of the USA Crusader Tank, each tank can build a single Battle Drone. Battle Drones are small robotic helpers that automatically engage enemies and repair their Crusader Tank in case it is damaged by enemy fire

label: SCRIPT:TrainingObjective

label: SCRIPT:TrainingUrban

label: SCRIPT:TrainingTech

text: Tactical Analysis

label: ACADEMY:BuildAllStructures
text: When you're on the battlefield it's important to utilize all the tools available to you, General. Make sure you build all the structures. You must maintain a strong military force

label: ACADEMY:BuildSupplyCenterEarlier
text: General, one of the most important functions of a strong leader is making sure that the soldiers have plenty of supplies. We suggest that you make sure to build a Supply Center or Stash whenever you begin a mission. Supplies bring you cash and cash brings you victory

label: ACADEMY:TryBuildingRadar
text: The Fog of War surrounds us all. One helpful way to see through the pea soup is via radar. Each faction is unique in how it obtains the eye in the sky. The USA Command Center automatically comes with radar, the Chinese Command Center must be upgraded and the GLA must build a Radar Van from its Arms Dealer

label: ACADEMY:BuildMorePeons
text: If you ask any other Generals they'll confirm a simple rule: The grunts make the army. In order to build your base you'll need to put your Dozers or Workers to work. These guys are key to your future success so don't forget them!

label: ACADEMY:TryCapturingStructures
text: General, sometimes it's easier to take what you want rather than work for it. If you build the "Capture" upgrade from your Barracks you'll be able to steal enemy structures. There are also Tech Buildings littered around the battlefield that can enhance your army even further

label: ACADEMY:SpendGeneralsPoints
text: With war come the spoils. Every time you destroy an enemy you'll earn your way toward more Generals Points. These can be spent by pressing the "star" button on the right side of the Command Bar. Simply open the Generals Points menu and spend your hard earned points on some new war toys

label: ACADEMY:TryUsingSuperweapons
text: What's the use of collecting Generals points if you don't use them? If you've purchased Generals Powers by using your points an icon will pop up on the right side of the screen. Simply press it and watch the fireworks begin. The more points you spend, the more powerful the power

label: ACADEMY:TryGarrisoningAStructure
text: Soldiers can be effective in the open, but are deadlier when garrisoned inside civilian buildings. Select your soldiers and send them into an empty structure. They'll be protected by the walls - unless a Flash Bang, Toxin Tractor or Dragon Tank comes their way

label: ACADEMY:IdleBuildingUnits
text: General, fielding and leading a great army should be your highest goal. Make sure you're building your fighting units by clicking on a Barracks, War Factory, Airfield, etc. and then clicking a respective picture in the bottom Command Bar. It will be money well spent and will help you achieve victory

label: ACADEMY:TryDragSelectingUnits
text: Manipulating your army is one of the trickiest things a General must learn. While you can click on each individual unit, it's usually faster to "lasso" a group of units. Simply click and drag the box around the units. They will now be in your control. If you click on another area the units will move to this spot

label: ACADEMY:ResearchUpgrades
text: A great General can make a lot of tanks, but a greater General can make a lot of better tanks. Almost every unit has some form of upgrade. It's often best to spend your money on improving what you already have

label: ACADEMY:RanOutOfPower
text: While the GLA has no need for power, China and the USA eat it up like popcorn. To keep a base running strong a General needs to spend money on plenty of power to supply the war machine. Make sure to build a Cold Fusion Reactor or a Nuclear Reactor for maximum output. Low power can mean a low success rate

label: ACADEMY:BuildMoreGatherers
text: General, make sure you're building plenty of Workers, Supply Trucks or Chinooks to keep your income flowing. You can make extra gatherers by clicking on rescource gatherer's picture in the Supply Center or Stash. Don't be shy about maximizing your resource potential

label: ACADEMY:BuildAHero
text: Jarmen Kell, Col. Burton and Black Lotus can be invaluable to your strategy. These heroes can turn the tide of a battle and are invisible to the enemy. To locate your hero on the radar, look for the cross hair icon. Though you can only build one at a time don't underestimate their importance

label: ACADEMY:PickStrategyCenterPlan
text: The US Strategy Center is a very helpful structure. You should remember to choose the strategy that best fits your gameplan. Search & Destroy, Bombardment and Hold the Line are all excellent ways to give you the edge you need. Along with these overall strategies you can purchase many upgrades from this building

label: ACADEMY:UseTunnelNetwork
text: When it comes to the GLA sneaking around the battlefield is their calling card. Tunnel Networks offer defense capabilities but they also allow the player to move around quickly. Simply build a few Tunnel Networks and send your units inside. Click on the structure and you can expel them from any other Tunnel Network anywhere on the map. They are key to the overall GLA strategy

label: ACADEMY:UseControlGroups
text: Managing a large army can be a bit unruly sometimes. One way to manage lots of units easily is by creating a "control group". Simply select the group of units in question and press "Ctrl" & a number at the same time. Now anytime you press this number, the group of units will be selected. Tap the number twice quickly and the camera view will center over the group

label: ACADEMY:UseSecondaryIncomeMethods
text: General, acquiring supplies later in a mission can be difficult. Each faction has a unique way to gain funds during long battles. China can build Hackers and an Internet Center. You can direct the Hackers to hack the internet for funds anywhere or just send them inside Internet Center to gain money even quicker. The GLA depends on the Black Market and the USA relies on the Supply Drop. If you don't plan ahead you may have shortages

label: ACADEMY:ClearBuildings
text: Garrisoned buildings can be tough to handle - unless you know some tricks. Upgrade your USA Rangers with Flash Bangs, build GLA Toxin Tractors or Chinese Dragon Tanks to quickly clear out these strong points. The USA also can upgrade to the Bunker Buster to even clear out Tunnel Networks!

label: ACADEMY:PickUpSalvage
text: The GLA is a sneaky bunch but they're also resourceful. Whenever the GLA units destroy another vehicle a salvage bonus is left behind. Roll over the salvaged parts to upgrade your units, gain veterancy or get some extra cash. Salvage can make a big difference in a long fight so don't leave it just lying around

label: ACADEMY:UseGuardAbility
text: Sometimes it's important that units stay put and guard a particular area. Simply select the unit and press the "shield" button or "G" key and then select the area to be guarded. The unit will attack any enemies that enter its guard radius

label: ACADEMY:MultipleSupplyCenters
text: Supplies are the name on the game, General. They can be gathered at Supply Docks littered around the battlefield. While one dock may be enough early on it's usually best to branch out and find a few more during a mission. You'll need to build a Supply Center or Stash close to the Supply Dock to ensure efficient collection

label: ACADEMY:GarrionVehicle
text: Some units may enter or steal other vehicles. Stealing vehicles with Hijackers or Terrorists can allow you to sneak into enemy territory

label: ACADEMY:UseSelectionHotkeys
text: General, hotkeys are a great way to enhance your control of your forces. "E" will select all of the same unit types on the view screen. If you tap "E" twice quickly it will select all the same type across the entire battlefield. "Q" will select all your combat units on the map. "W" will select all your air units on the map. Give them a try, they'll help you out

label: ACADEMY:AlternateMouseInterface
text: One new addition is the "Alternate Mouse Interface" option located in the Options Menu. If you are used to commanding armies using right click as your action button then this may help you get a better handle on your army

label: ACADEMY:DoubleClickAttackMoveGuard
text: General, we have created a new way to direct your army. Simply select your units and double click the destination area. Your units will attack-move to the spot and then guard it. You may enable this through the options menu

label: ACADEMY:BuildBarracksSooner
text: In order to create a well balanced force you must build a Barracks earlier in the mission. Infantry can make or break your gameplan so it's best not to forget them

label: ACADEMY:BuildWarFactorySooner
text: While infantry and airpower can be great assets nothing quite beats a good tank. Be sure to build a War Factory or Arms Dealer earlier in the mission

label: ACADEMY:BuildTechStructureSooner
text: For the advanced weaponry there is no replacement for a Strategy Center, Propaganda Center or Palace. Don't forget to build one a bit earlier in missions to ensure success

label: ACADEMY:NoIncome
text: General, it's vital to your success that your income flow continues throughout the mission. Too many gaps lead to losing your edge. Make sure you're keeping the supplies rolling in consistently

label: ACADEMY:ClearMines
text: Demo Traps and mines can really be the start of a bad day. These sneaky tactics can be combated by using Dozers or Workers to clear these dangerous areas out

label: ACADEMY:UnmannedVehicles
text: General, some units can snipe or remove enemy drivers of a vehicles. When this occurs the vehicles become neutral and can be "borrowed" from the enemy. Feel free to go for a ride at your enemy's expense

label: ACADEMY:DisguisedUnits
text: Some units can disguise themselves as other units. There is nothing quite as satisfying as rolling a GLA Bomb Truck into an enemy base undetected and causing lots of havoc. Make sure to use this key tactic to further your battle plan

label: ACADEMY:StealthUpgrade
text: Some structures can be upgraded to camouflage, like the GLA Tunnel Network or Stinger Sites. These will be invisible to the enemy until its too late. Surprise!

label: ACADEMY:Firestorm
text: China has the unique ability to create a Firestorm when multiple MiGs or Inferno Cannons target a single enemy or area. Make sure to coordinate your attacks for maximum effect

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf01Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA managed to defeat the US forces in this area. We launched a devastating counter attack, but like roaches they are still alive

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Even now the GLA survivors are rebuilding

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf03Subtitle
text: *To finally eliminate the GLA we must send in our forces and root them out of every dark corner in which they hide

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf04Subtitle
text: *General, our new Listening Outposts are stationed in the area. They are at your disposal

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf05Subtitle
text: *The Listening Outpost itself is unarmed, however its passengers can fire on enemies that venture too close. You will find its long sight range and stealth ability greatly enhances battlefield awareness

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat01Subtitle
text: *No GLA will slip past our garrison

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat02Subtitle
text: *Toxin Tractors! They're trying to poison us allwe need support!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat03Subtitle
text: *LookOil Derricksshould we capture them?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat04Subtitle
text: *GLA in your home? Apply a little fireno more GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat05Subtitle
text: *The GLA are rebuilding over therestand ready to attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat06Subtitle
text: *We will win this dayeveryone advance

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01aSubtitle
text: *I did not think the United States would be defeated so easily

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01bSubtitle
text: *I do not understand why the United States has allowed this to happen

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01cSubtitle
text: *This can not be allowed to stand. China will make things right

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01dSubtitle
text: *The GLA's treacherous use of our resources against the Americans has caused great embarrassment to China. They must pay for their insolence

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin02Subtitle
text: *The missiles are prepared and ready for launchfinal countdown started

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin03Subtitle
text: *321 Missiles are away

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin04Subtitle
text: *They believe they have won the day, but they celebrate too soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin05Subtitle
text: *It is pretty when used for the right reasons

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin06Subtitle
text: *GLA survivors are running to town for coverthey must be stopped!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin07Subtitle
text: *We are in positionbomb bay doors open

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin08Subtitle
text: *We have spotted survivors. Ground assault will be necessary

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO01Subtitle
text: *General, our former base in the region was overrun by the GLA. You will need to construct a new base before you can engage the enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO02Subtitle
text: *May I suggest that you garrison several of the nearby buildings to defend our base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO03Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA has garrisoned several buildings throughout the town. Perhaps you could use a Dragon tank to clear out those garrisons

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO04Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA is moving Toxin Tractors towards our garrisoned buildings. If those tractors attack those buildings, everyone inside will be eliminated

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO05Subtitle
text: *The GLA are using these Oil Derricks to fund their forces. One of our Red Guard could capture those derricks. The proceeds would help defeat the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO06Subtitle
text: *General, is it wise to destroy these Oil Derricks? They would provide valuable resources for us. One of our Red Guard could capture them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO07Subtitle
text: *You have caught them off-guard, General. One of your Red Guard could capture their buildings before they are able to respond

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO08Subtitle
text: *Now that you have re-established our base of operations, it is time to root out all remaining GLA forces in the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO09Subtitle
text: *Congratulations, General. You have freed the town of all GLA forces. Once you have wiped out their final base, your mission will be complete

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi02Lin13Subtitle
text: *The Terrorist threat is finished. Good work, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf01Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA are attempting to steal the nuclear warheads stored at this facility

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf01aSubtitle
text: *General, the GLA are attempting to destroy our main nuclear power plant

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Our brave soldiers held off their attack but at great cost and the GLA is still out there

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf03Subtitle
text: *You must hold off the GLA and insure that every one of our Bunkers is protected

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf03aSubtitle
text: *You must hold off the GLA to insure that the facility is not destroyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf04Subtitle
text: *We have several new technologies that should be of great benefit to your mission, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf05Subtitle
text: *Our Nuclear Cannons are now upgraded to fire neutron shells. These new shells effectively eliminate soldiers and vehicle drivers. Once the radiation has cleared, one of our infantrymen can then capture the surviving vehicles

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf06Subtitle
text: *Our buildings can now upgrade to Neutron mines. While still effective against infantry, they will also temporarily incapacitate enemy vehicles

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07aSubtitle
text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 15 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07bSubtitle
text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 10 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07cSubtitle
text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 5 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07dSubtitle
text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat01Subtitle
text: *Enemy forces sighted. We will hold them back

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat02Subtitle
text: *We're taking fire on the right flanksupport is needed here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat03Subtitle
text: *They are behind usdirect all fire to the south!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat04Subtitle
text: *GLA base in rangeall teams ready to attack, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat05Subtitle
text: *Enemy buildings on that ridge. Give the word, General, and we will roll over them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat06Subtitle
text: *Watch those RPG Troopers! We need help!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat07Subtitle
text: *General, we are over the target area now and have commenced bombing

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat08Subtitle
text: *Rolling out the carpetof bombs. Heheh

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat09Subtitle
text: *Enemy air defenses are thick herewe are taking heavy damage

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat10Subtitle
text: *Stinger sites have locked onto uswe are in trouble!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat11Subtitle
text: *Stop that Rebel, he's trying to capture our bunker!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat12Subtitle
text: *It isn't a Battlemaster, but it will have to do

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat13Subtitle
text: *I prefer my Gattling Tank

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat14Subtitle
text: *Another GLA wave!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat15Subtitle
text: *We must protect our bunkers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat15aSubtitle
text: *We must protect the nuclear reactor!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat16Subtitle
text: *Now we will show them how to attack a base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat17Subtitle
text: *Reinforcements! We are glad to see you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat18Subtitle
text: *We are ready for your orders, General. Where do you need us?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01Subtitle
text: *We must be on our guard. Reports say the GLA might attack as revenge for our entering the war

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01aSubtitle
text: *I don't feel safe guarding this nuclear plant

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01bSubtitle
text: *Yah. I wish I had joined up with the air force instead

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01dSubtitle
text: *Surely after our recent victory they would not dare to attack us here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01cSubtitle
text: *Their food is much better. And they get to wear those fancy helmets

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin02Subtitle
text: *GLA forces! We're under attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin03Subtitle
text: *They're everywhere! We're being overrun

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04Subtitle
text: *Another wave! We need reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04aSubtitle
text: *Another wave! They've got bomb trucks and terrorists! We need reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04bSubtitle
text: *Another wave! They're using suicide tactics! Where are those reinforcements?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin05Subtitle
text: *We've lost the airfield!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin06Subtitle
text: *They're trying to get to the storage bunkers! Protect them at all costs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin06aSubtitle
text: *They're trying to get to the main reactor! Protect it at all costs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin07Subtitle
text: *The Command Centerthey got the Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin08Subtitle
text: *We held remaining forces report in

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin09Subtitle
text: *Not much left. We're going to need reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin10Subtitle
text: *The message got through, but we'll have to hold until they get here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO01Subtitle
text: *General, our reinforcements have arrived!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO02Subtitle
text: *General, GLA forces are attacking the bunkers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO02aSubtitle
text: *General, GLA forces are attacking the nuclear plant!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO03Subtitle
text: *The GLA is attempting to capture one of our bunkers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO04Subtitle
text: *General, this bunker is badly damaged. May I suggest it be repaired before another GLA attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO04aSubtitle
text: *General, our nuclear plant is badly damaged. May I suggest it be repaired before another GLA attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO05Subtitle
text: *General, that last attack severely weakened several bunkers. If one of them is destroyed, the GLA will win this encounter

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO05aSubtitle
text: *General, that last attack severely weakened the nuclear plant. If it is destroyed, we will fail our mission!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO06Subtitle
text: *WarningGLA forces moving towards the bunkers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO06aSubtitle
text: *WarningGLA forces are moving towards the power plant!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO07Subtitle
text: *General, I've made contact with one of our spy outposts. They are under GLA attack. If we can rescue them, I can patch into their system and we will be able to call in carpet bombers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO08Subtitle
text: *General, if you can secure that spy outpost, it will allow you to direct carpet bombing runs on the GLA forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO09Subtitle
text: *General, now that our reinforcements have arrived it is time to eliminate the GLA from this area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi03RedChat12Subtitle
text: *To battle!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi03RedChat19Subtitle
text: *Bring in the tanks! Level them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf01Subtitle
text: *Greetings, Commander. Now that we have thwarted the GLA's counterattack, it is time to press our advantage!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf02Subtitle
text: *We must liberate this town from the GLA's clutches

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf03Subtitle
text: *There is a very heavily defended GLA base north of the river. We must destroy it, but it will not be an easy task

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Our operations have attracted much attention from the rest of the world, and we will be watched closely. The longer this battle goes on, the lower our International Opinion will fall

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf05Subtitle
text: *Damage to civilian property must be avoided. Our operation must be precise, and swift. Destruction of GLA forces will cause International Opinion to rise, in our favor

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf09Subtitle
text: *If our International Opinion becomes high enough, the people of the town might join our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf10Subtitle
text: *It will then be easy to annihilate the GLA's defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat01Subtitle
text: *They must have a camouflaged Tunnel Network near here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat02Subtitle
text: *They've ambushed us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat03Subtitle
text: *They've ambushed our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat04Subtitle
text: *We have found their secret base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat05Subtitle
text: *They are coming from the far side of the lake

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat06Subtitle
text: *Their troops must be hidden in the forest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat07Subtitle
text: *I wonder what's across the river

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat08Subtitle
text: *Their hit-and-run attacks are proving inconvenient

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat09Subtitle
text: *The buggies are back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat10Subtitle
text: *Sneak attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat11Subtitle
text: *Crush that Inferno Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat12Subtitle
text: *The people are too afraid to come out from their homes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat13Subtitle
text: *We must free them from this oppression!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO01Subtitle
text: *The people rise to support us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO10Subtitle
text: *General. Destroying the GLA statues will be critical to increasing our International Opinion and will boost support of our efforts amongst the population

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO11Subtitle
text: *They have dispatched a Toxic Tractor to clear our garrisonned structures!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO12Subtitle
text: *Our Dragon Tanks will be a high priority targetguard them well

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO13Subtitle
text: *Well done, sir. The destruction of the statue has caused world opinion to rise

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO16Subtitle
text: *Do not let them destroy the buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO17Subtitle
text: *Use the Neutron Shell to clear buildings without damaging them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO18Subtitle
text: *Beware! Their defensive structures are hidden with camo-netting

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO19Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA have the city well-defended. We need to clear them out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO20Subtitle
text: *You're making good progress, Commander. Much of the city is now free of GLA control

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO21Subtitle
text: *Sir! The city is rising up against our foes!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO22Subtitle
text: *General, we must clear the GLA from this area!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO23Subtitle
text: *Our International Opinion is high. Great work!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat01Subtitle
text: *They have almost escaped! We must stop them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat010Subtitle
text: *They are skirting the lake. Intercept them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat011Subtitle
text: *They're coming for our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat012Subtitle
text: *We have stopped the first wave of GLA!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat013Subtitle
text: *Again we have put them in their place!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat014Subtitle
text: *No one can stand to the might of China!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat015Subtitle
text: *Sun Tzu would be proud

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat016Subtitle
text: *Victory is ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat017Subtitle
text: *None shall pass

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat018Subtitle
text: *We will banish them from the skies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat019Subtitle
text: *Our power is unsurpassed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat02Subtitle
text: *Cut them off at the village!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat020Subtitle
text: *The Helix isn't the only powerhouse

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat03Subtitle
text: *We cannot let them get past that hill

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat04Subtitle
text: *They will surely pass by here. We should defend this area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat05Subtitle
text: *Here is another choke point

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat06Subtitle
text: *We should secure these buildings

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat07Subtitle
text: *What are they doing?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat08Subtitle
text: *Watch out for the toxin!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat09Subtitle
text: *We've been ambushed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat15Subtitle
text: *Our forces are in position. We are ready for anything

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat16Subtitle
text: *They are stronger than we thought. We need air support. Send in the Helix now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO01Subtitle
text: *The GLA is sending forth another wave!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO02Subtitle
text: *This wave is retreating towards the north

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO03Subtitle
text: *They are retreating to the northeast

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO04Subtitle
text: *This wave is retreating to the east

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO05Subtitle
text: *The European Union is extremely pleased with our performance, General. We need to stay aggressive and eliminate the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO06Subtitle
text: *This force was only a diversion!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO07Subtitle
text: *General, they have a scud storm! We must spread out our troops to deny them a target!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO08Subtitle
text: *Waitthey're not targeting us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO09Subtitle
text: *The GLA have no honor! They have decimated the village to clear a path!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO10Subtitle
text: *We should assemble a base to secure this region

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO11Subtitle
text: *Our Helix is the Overlord of the skies. Build more to help us control the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO12Subtitle
text: *Sir, I recommend placing Listening Outposts at key locations

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO13Subtitle
text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO14Subtitle
text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. If too many of them escape, our mission will be a failure. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO15Subtitle
text: *A wave of GLA is approaching from the west

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO16Subtitle
text: *There is a wave of GLA approaching from the south

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO17Subtitle
text: *GLA forces have been spotted approaching from the southwest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO18Subtitle
text: *GLA forces incoming from the southeast

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO19Subtitle
text: *A wave of GLA forces are approaching from the southwest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO20Subtitle
text: *Another GLA wave is approaching

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO21Subtitle
text: *Excellent work, sir. Intel confirms that you have destroyed the entire wave

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO22Subtitle
text: *The enemy is about to breach our defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO23Subtitle
text: *Multiple Scud Storm launches detected

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO24Subtitle
text: *Our defenses have been breached commander, we have failed the mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO25Subtitle
text: *Commander, our forces from the south have arrived. Out mission was a success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO26Subtitle
text: *General, enemy forces are dangerously close to making their escape. We must deal with them quickly!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO27Subtitle
text: *GLA forces have been detected fleeing through this location. Move into defensive positions and await enemy contact

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO28Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 1 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO29Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 2 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO30Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 3 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO31Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 4 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO32Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 5 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO33Subtitle
text: *Our forces have arrived from the south. You have been successful in preventing the enemy retreat. Good job General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO34Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy forces have escaped to the North. We have failed the mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC01Subtitle
text: *It's time we corrected our mistake. Kill them all!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC02Subtitle
text: *Let us flush these rats from their holes. Death to the cowards!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf01Subtitle
text: *Thanks to your remarkable efforts in Halberstadt the GLA are all but finished. US intel has located the last GLA stronghold outside of Hamburg. Unfortunately we were too late to help the Americans in this area and the GLA captured their base. Build your forces and destroy both the GLA and US bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf02Subtitle
text: *The GLA have captured an old US base in the region and are building up. Your Final Objective is to Destroy both the US and GLA bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf03Subtitle
text: *The GLA have increased their stealth abilities, General. They can now stealth just about anything. We'll need to stay alert

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Use your Listening Outposts to detect stealthed units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf05Subtitle
text: *General, I suggest you first concentrate your attack on the US base. We need to take out their Particle Cannons

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xChat01Subtitle
text: *It feels like we are on an Easter Egg hunt, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin01Subtitle
text: *Corporal! Any sign of the Chinese yet?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin02Subtitle
text: *No sir, the last message received was at 02:00nothing since

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin03Subtitle
text: *Well, I hope they get here soon. Our intel points to a full-scale GLA attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin04Subtitle
text: *Yes, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin06Subtitle
text: *What the...!? Enemy contact!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin07Subtitle
text: *Our base has been breached.all units to your stations! Where are those Chinese we were promised!?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin08Subtitle
text: *Fox in the hole! Fox in the hole!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin09Subtitle
text: *Where'd they come from?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin10Subtitle
text: *They're capturing our buildings! We can't hold! All units, fall back! Repeat, fall back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO01Subtitle
text: *That's it! Power to the US base is down! Finish them quickly before they can rebuild!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO02Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce US units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO03Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce GLA units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO04Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The US base has been neutralized. Destroy the GLA base to finish this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO05Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The GLA base has been neutralized. Destroy the US base to finish this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO06Subtitle
text: *We must finish what the US was not able to do. The GLA must fall and the world will be at peace

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO07Subtitle
text: *If we are able to defeat the GLA and save Europe from its clutches then there are great rewards to be had

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO08Subtitle
text: *General, you will take your place among China's finest heroes. The GLA has fallen and China is the shining beacon in a new world. Take you place of honor and bask in the glory that is China

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO09Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has improved their stealth ability, but they do not appear to be using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO10Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA commander is lacking tanks. Perhaps we can overwhelm him with our forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO11Subtitle
text: *General, we are losing vehicles to Jarmen Kell. You must track him down if we are to stand a chance

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO12Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy is using HIJACKERS! We need to stop them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO13Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has positioned SNIPERs in the local villages. We must clear them out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO14Subtitle
text: *General, we are losing troops to the enemy's Quad Cannons, we need heavy armor out here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO15Subtitle
text: *General, current intel suggests Jarmen Kell may be holed up in this small village

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO16Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy's base seems to be on the other side of this river. Perhaps we can lock him in by positioning forces near the bridges

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO17Subtitle
text: *General, we have many driverless vehicles in the fieldsend units to recapture them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO18Subtitle
text: *Sir! We have detected Battle buses in sector C. We should deal with them before they can reach our base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO19Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has slipped units into our base! We should improve our defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO20Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has infiltrated our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO21Subtitle
text: *General! Taking out the American Command Center will put a stop to his heavy Air support

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO22Subtitle
text: *General, we need to get our INTERNET CENTER built as quickly as possible. It will help us locate enemy positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO23Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has left his Flank unguarded! Now is our chance to counter attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO24Subtitle
text: *General, the Americans have superior stealth detection technology. Perhaps you should capture this base instead of destroying it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi07RedGuard108Subtitle
text: *Ambush!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion105Subtitle
text: *The Chinese are close

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion108Subtitle
text: *We have found a secret way. It's poorly guarded

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion109Subtitle
text: *We're under fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat01Subtitle
text: *Enemy defense structures sighted, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat02Subtitle
text: *Enemy position spotted! We must find a way past them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat03Subtitle
text: *Enemy patrol! All units, open fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat04Subtitle
text: *American Sentry Drones! We must destroy them quickly before they sound the alarm!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat05Subtitle
text: *Look at them scramble! Our attack was a complete surprise!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat06Subtitle
text: *American attackers closing in! We must hold our position, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat07Subtitle
text: *Our surprise was complete! All units, concentrate on their power plants!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat08Subtitle
text: *General! We are taking heavy losses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin01Subtitle
text: *Patrol to base: Target has been located and we are in pursuit

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin02Subtitle
text: *Be advised, the bombing campaign has already begun. Be careful, Patrol

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin03Subtitle
text: *Roger that, base. I'm on the right

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin04Subtitle
text: *I'll take the left

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin05Subtitle
text: *I'm taking fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin06Subtitle
text: *Stay on them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin07Subtitle
text: *Look out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin08Subtitle
text: *Base! Charlie three is down! Repeat: Charlie three is down!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin09Subtitle
text: *Continue pursuit, Charlie two! This is our best shot at him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin10Subtitle
text: *Escorts eliminated! I've got him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin11Subtitle
text: *Nooooo!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin12Subtitle
text: *Heh heh. General, we've made our escape.and are headed for the rendevouz point. The GLA shall rise again

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin13Subtitle
text: *Affirmative. Scout team moving out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin14Subtitle
text: *This is scout team. We detect no enemy presence. Wait

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin15Subtitle
text: *American ambush! They have us surrounded!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin16Subtitle
text: *Sentry Drones! These Americans are most clever. Their drones are hidden when they are still. You must proceed with caution, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen01Subtitle
text: *The Americans have surrounded our stronghold with military checkpoints. You must clear the way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen02Subtitle
text: *General, you must help our true leader escape, so that the GLA can live on

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen03Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax may have died for the cause but he was inconsequential. If our brother escapes the US will not have seen the last of the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen04Subtitle
text: *General. The Fire Base defenses around this American position are too strong. We should avoid a direct confrontation and find another way into the base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen05Subtitle
text: *Hold you forces back, General. We are sending in a team to scout the other side of the bridge. They will report back on enemy positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen06Subtitle
text: *My General. One of our Quick Strike teams has managed to elude their American pursuers, and have agreed to aid us in our mission. Their rocket pods should prove most useful against enemy armor

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen07Subtitle
text: *We have discovered one of our demolitions teams. They will help us to clear a path by destroying the outlying US support bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen08Subtitle
text: *General. We must secure the airfield before the transport plane arrives. The survival of the GLA depends on your success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen09Subtitle
text: *Our Combat Cycles are very versatile. They enhance the abilities of our loyal infantry, and are able to travel over rough terrain. They are even able to survive a jump off cliffs. Use them to bypass American strong-points and attack their vulnerable sides

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen10Subtitle
text: *General! The Americans have sent a second group of pursuers to capture our leader. Protect him at all costs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen11Subtitle
text: *General, this hidden base can provide us with the resources we need to push past the American siege and reach the airfield

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen12Subtitle
text: *General, our leader is under attack! He must not fall to the Americans!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen13Subtitle
text: *General, your forces are moving too far ahead of our leader. Remember that he must reach the airfield if our cause is to survive

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen14Subtitle
text: *Another American base. It must be eliminated. Be wary of their Fire Bases, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen15Subtitle
text: *We are within reach of the airfield, General. Destroy the American forces and secure the area that we may fly our leader to safety

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen16Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. With you in command, we can not fail

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen17Subtitle
text: *We have reached the airfield, sir. Make sure our leader is ready and waiting at the air strip when his plane arrives

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen18Subtitle
text: *Our plane is on approach, General! Just hold your position for a little longer. Our leader must survive to board that plane!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen19Subtitle
text: *The plane has arrived. Load our leader in so that we may fly him to safety and regroup

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen20Subtitle
text: *The plane is waiting for our leader to board. Make haste and bring him in, General. Our forces cannot hold out indefinitely against the Americans

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen21Subtitle
text: *Our operative, Jarmen Kell, has been harassing the American supply lines. He will be of great help to our mission, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen22Subtitle
text: *Excellent work, General. We will show the Americans that we still have the power to resist them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen23Subtitle
text: *We have discovered an advance scout force, General. They have offered to aid us with our mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen24Subtitle
text: *General! Take out the American power plants to shut down their base defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen25Subtitle
text: *Our forces have been weakened, General. We must choose our battles more wisely

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter04Subtitle
text: *We are here and ready for your command

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter18Subtitle
text: *So much for American

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02General07Subtitle
text: *American forces are coming. Get ready!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat01Subtitle
text: *The enemy, they are attacking!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat02Subtitle
text: *The resistance is too strong, there must be another way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat03Subtitle
text: *The Prince must be stopped. The GLA must not fall to him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat04Subtitle
text: *Our base is under attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat05Subtitle
text: *Our Palace is destroyed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat06Subtitle
text: *We have lost our Barracks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat07Subtitle
text: *We must rebuild our Arms Dealer quickly

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin01Subtitle
text: *This is Recon 1 to base. I am finishing my patrol. Sector is clear

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin02Subtitle
text: *This is base. Are you certain, Recon 1? We've had reports of troop movements linked to Prince Kassad

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin03Subtitle
text: *I am most certain. I haven't seen anything but dust and shrubs for hours now. Returning to base after this

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin04Subtitle
text: *What the?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin05Subtitle
text: *Recon 1 to base! Enemy contact! Repeat, enemy contact!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin06Subtitle
text: *Recon 1! What is your position?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin07Subtitle
text: *He's preparing to fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin08Subtitle
text: *Recon 1, what is your status? Recon 1! Report!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin09Subtitle
text: *Once Prince Kassad is removed the GLA will be under our control. Then vengeance will be ours and the American infidels will burn

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin10Subtitle
text: *Prince Kassad is beginning to take control wherever he can. We must put an end to his vie for power

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen01Subtitle
text: *General, our resources are running low -- we must find a new source of supplies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen02Subtitle
text: *Kassad is attempting to capture nearby resources! We must not let him take what is rightfully ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen03Subtitle
text: *We must reunite the GLA under one leader!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen04Subtitle
text: *Beware! Kassad has launched a sneak attack against us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen05Subtitle
text: *We have much bigger plans than that rat Kassad. The world will quake as we unleash the fury of the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen06Subtitle
text: *We have acquired GPS Scramble technology! Now we can use Kassad's tricks against him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen07Subtitle
text: *Excellent, General! We have secured the Sneak Attack ability!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen08Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Centers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen09Subtitle
text: *If we can capture the enemy Command Center we can use their technology against them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen10Subtitle
text: *General, we must capture their Command Center and use their knowledge to progress towards our goal of uniting the GLA under one flag

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen11Subtitle
text: *We are running low on resources. We must capture some oil derricks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen12Subtitle
text: *Our enemy is attacking our Oil Supply! They must be stopped!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen13Subtitle
text: *Use the GPS scramble to sneak past the enemy defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen14Subtitle
text: *The GPS Scramble will not work here, there are too many Stinger Sites.We will need to use a different tactic

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen15Subtitle
text: *Perhaps we can find an unguarded area to use our new Sneak Attack ability

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen16Subtitle
text: *Do not destroy the Command Center. We need to capture the structure and keep it intact

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen17Subtitle
text: *Their knowledge must be stolen. We need to use their advanced tactics to defeat them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen18Subtitle
text: *General, be wary of snipers -- Kassad loves to use them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen19Subtitle
text: *This bridge is heavily defended. We will need assistance in getting across it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen20Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the North!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen21Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the West!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen22Subtitle
text: *General, if we capture this cannon, we can use it against Kassad's forces!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen23Subtitle
text: *If we capture the Command Center, we can use their abilities to turn the tide of this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen24Subtitle
text: *Prince Kassad is no more. The GLA are once again united against our enemies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen25Subtitle
text: *Now that we have GPS scramble, we can move unseen past Kassad's bridge defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen26Subtitle
text: *The traitor has fortified himself on this hilltop and cut all other means of access. Sneak Attack is the only way we have to strike at his main base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen27Subtitle
text: *General, this area is being controlled by Prince Kassad. He has turned his back on his brethren and will not aid us in our cause against the infidels

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen28Subtitle
text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, hiding his forces in plain sight. He refuses to share his knowledge with us, so we will take it from him

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen29Subtitle
text: *A GLA splinter cell commanded by Prince Kassad is controlling this area. Kassad refuses to let us use his abilities for the good of the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen30Subtitle
text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, relying on several techniques to surprise and attack his enemies

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen31Subtitle
text: *GPS scramble gives him the power to have any unit strike unseen against an enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen32Subtitle
text: *Tunnel sneak attacks offer further tactical advantages

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen33Subtitle
text: *We must have these technologies. If Kassad will not share, we will take them from him. Capture his command centers and turn his own abilities against him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar03Subtitle
text: *Free our imprisoned brothers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar15Subtitle
text: *We have spotted a Prison Camp, our brothers are held inside

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf01Subtitle
text: *Welcome, Commander!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Kassad was too cowardly to make an attempt against the US such as this. General, you are truly a master mind

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf03Subtitle
text: *Once the US Mediterranean naval force is shattered all of Europe will be in our grasp

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Now that we are again united, it is time to make our strength felt!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf05Subtitle
text: *The USA has attacked our secret base in the Mediterranean

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf06Subtitle
text: *But before it was wiped out, we learned of the location of their Particle Cannon and naval fleet in the region

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf07Subtitle
text: *Most of their ships are in port and helpless. We will steal their Particle Cannon and use it to take out their Aircraft Carrier!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf08Subtitle
text: *Look for an opportunity to reclaim and rebuild our secret base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat01Subtitle
text: *We'll die for you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat02Subtitle
text: *Another one bites the dust

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat03Subtitle
text: *More victims for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat04Subtitle
text: *Mow them down!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat05Subtitle
text: *They cannot escape our wrath!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat06Subtitle
text: *We have them where we want them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat07Subtitle
text: *Victory will be ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat08Subtitle
text: *That made a big splash!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin01Subtitle
text: *We will avenge this cowardly attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin02Subtitle
text: *Their carrier will be turned into scrap!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin03Subtitle
text: *We have proven the might of the GLA!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen01Subtitle
text: *Our Hijackers could take that tank easily

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen02Subtitle
text: *That Ranger is running for help! We must not let him get away

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen03Subtitle
text: *We'll need this Particle Cannon to sink the enemy Carrier. Defend it well!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen04Subtitle
text: *Our rebels can use their Capture Building ability to take control of the Particle Cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen05Subtitle
text: *We can use our Sneak Attack to create Tunnel Networks on nearby islands

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen06Subtitle
text: *We must not let the pilot reach his Tomahawk!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen07Subtitle
text: *They're coming after the Tomahawk!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen08Subtitle
text: *This Barracks is now ours

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen09Subtitle
text: *We have liberated this Palace

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen10Subtitle
text: *This Arms Dealer will serve us well

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen11Subtitle
text: *We have reclaimed our Command Center!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen12Subtitle
text: *General, do you see those enemy supply planes? If we could destroy their drop zones, we would cripple their production!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen13Subtitle
text: *Ah, this toxic tractor will come in handy

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen14Subtitle
text: *These Quad Cannons will defend us from enemy aircraft

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen15Subtitle
text: *These Marauders will boost our firepower

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen16Subtitle
text: *Destroy these tanks and we can liberate the Barracks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen17Subtitle
text: *If we clear this area, we can safely occupy the Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen18Subtitle
text: *Kill those troops and the Arms Dealer will be ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen19Subtitle
text: *They may be launching an attack against us! Defend our buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen20Subtitle
text: *Comanches! Rally our air defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen21Subtitle
text: *We must defend against those Comanches!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen22Subtitle
text: *They are trying to retake the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen23Subtitle
text: *Their aircraft have destroyed our Tunnel Network!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen24Subtitle
text: *Those clever villains! They are targeting our Power Plants. We need power to use the Particle Cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen25Subtitle
text: *Almost all of the power plants have been destroyed. We must have power to use the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen26Subtitle
text: *If we could capture some power plants, we could use the Particle Cannon against them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen27Subtitle
text: *Ahh.. We have found some hidden goodies

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen28Subtitle
text: *This pass is well defended. We should use the Particle Cannon to blast through

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen29Subtitle
text: *Be careful! This pass is heavily guarded!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen30Subtitle
text: *They've dispatched infantry onto the islands!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen31Subtitle
text: *They're choppers are bringing reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen32Subtitle
text: *They have launched an A10 Strike against us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen33Subtitle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva06Subtitle
text: *Get that Dragon Tank up there to clear out those buildings

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva07Subtitle
text: *Build more units. We don't want to fail in our surprise attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva08Subtitle
text: *General! Get your men out of the pit! We've got MOABS on the way that are gonna blow this place to bits

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva09Subtitle
text: *We need to finish destroying this base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva10Subtitle
text: *The MOABs will be here any minute!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva11Subtitle
text: *Alpha Wing! Area is clear. You may proceed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva12Subtitle
text: *Good work, General. It looks like the GLA threat has finally been removed. It's time to put all this behind us and get looking for those WMDs

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02Comanche101Subtitle
text: *Thanks for getting me out, sir! Things were getting a little dicey for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02Comanche204Subtitle
text: *They're swarming us, sir!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xBrf01Subtitle
text: *The docks have been cleared, General. Our first task will be to hold them while the supply trucks are brought in. Until the Dozers arrive, we will have to defend this position with our troops as they filter in

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Most of our fleet survived the GLA Baikonur Attack. Our Aircraft Carrier and Battleship escorts are at your disposal to aid with this operation

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat01Subtitle
text: *Air-strike Launched

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat02Subtitle
text: *Battleship commencing bombardment

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat03Subtitle
text: *Docks are all clear. No GLA in sight

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat04Subtitle
text: *Roger that

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat05Subtitle
text: *Commencing Attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat06Subtitle
text: *Launching Air-strike

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat07Subtitle
text: *Guns a blazing

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat08Subtitle
text: *We'll give them some red glare alright

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin01Subtitle
text: *Carrier Command to fleet. Keep up the fire, boys. The GLA are bringing in reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin02Subtitle
text: *Roger that, Carrier command. Maintaining suppression fire on the docks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin03Subtitle
text: *Be careful what you hit. We just want to clear it out, not destroy it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva01Subtitle
text: *Good work, sir! Our next objective is to provide safe passage for the supply trucks as they travel through the city. The trucks must reach the city's supply warehouse. We must also retain control of the docks. Good luck, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva02Subtitle
text: *Supply Trucks are beginning to move, General. We must provide protection as they make their way to the drop off point

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva03Subtitle
text: *I'm sending you some new prototype sentry drones. The enemy can't detect them if they stay still. The drones are also capable of spotting stealthed units as well as GLA demo traps. They should prove to be very useful

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva04Subtitle
text: *Our dozer has arrived sir! Begin building up your base. The GLA are preparing a new wave of attacks against us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva05Subtitle
text: *Great job, sir! The people of this city have expressed their gratitude for the relief supplies. Our final objective is to drive the GLA from the area. Destroy their main base overlooking the city and the area will be secured

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva06Subtitle
text: *Reinforcements incoming, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva07Subtitle
text: *General, our Sentry Drones can help spot GLA Demo Traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva08Subtitle
text: *Sir, there are still GLA near the warehouse. We need to clear them out immediately

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva09Subtitle
text: *Supply Trucks are under attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva10Subtitle
text: *Good job, all trucks are safely to the docks, now lets get them to the city

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva11Subtitle
text: *Try to minimize civilian casualties

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva12Subtitle
text: *You've discovered a GLA training camp, sir. Intelligence believes that members of this camp were partially responsible for the Baikonur Launch. We have been ordered to take it out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva13Subtitle
text: *Secure the warehouse so the supply trucks can proceed safely

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva14Subtitle
text: *Once the warehouse is secure the supply trucks will proceed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva15Subtitle
text: *Dozers have arrived general. You are cleared to eliminate the GLA at your discretion

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva16Subtitle
text: *Get the food to the city before the GLA can steal or destroy it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva17Subtitle
text: *General, we've done it. The city is free from the GLA tyranny. It looks like they've got some Intel that will lead us straight to those hidden WMDs

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva18Subtitle
text: *Full naval support is available for this operation

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva19Subtitle
text: *Use the battleships and aircraft carrier at your discretion

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva20Subtitle
text: *The battleships are in range and awaiting targets, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva21Subtitle
text: *The CVN Daedalus is standing by with aircraft at the ready

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva22Subtitle
text: *The warehouse needs to be secured, but the safety of the docks must not be compromised

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva23Subtitle
text: *Our forces are limited in this area. You will receive reinforcements as they become available

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva24Subtitle
text: *Secure the warehouse without compromising the safety of the docks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva25Subtitle
text: *The convoy has resupplied the warehouse

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva26Subtitle
text: *The GLA Base is the next objective, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply01Subtitle
text: *As soon as that warehouse is safe, we will roll out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply02Subtitle
text: *Thanks for the cover fire, General! All trucks loaded and ready to move out. Just clear out that city for us, sir!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply03Subtitle
text: *The streets are lined with Demo Traps, sir! We'll need them swept clear!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply04Subtitle
text: *We've reached the warehouse, General. Thanks for the escort!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply05Subtitle
text: *Convoy's arrived safely, sir. Thanks for the cover

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager01Subtitle
text: *Oh thank you

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager02Subtitle
text: *Bless You

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager03Subtitle
text: *I haven't eaten in so long

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager04Subtitle
text: *Will there be any more?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Comanche102Subtitle
text: *Quad Cannons are picking us apart, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader105Subtitle
text: *We need more support! They're chewing us up!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader108Subtitle
text: *Someone get those buggies off us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader304Subtitle
text: *Enemy contacts confirmed! They're moving in fast!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader307Subtitle
text: *All units! Keep up the fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf01Subtitle
text: *General, Col Burton and Black Lotus are in position and ready for your orders

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Their primary objective is this secret laboratory. It's location was revealed by the documents captured during your last mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf03Subtitle
text: *The GLA are working on a new weapon of mass destruction. Black Lotus must download this data so we know how far along their research has come

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Once she has completed her download, Col Burton must bring the mountainside down on the lab and bury it forever

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton01Subtitle
text: *We're at the bridge. Lotus, take care of that Scorpion, I'll deal with the other guards

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton02Subtitle
text: *That wasn't part of the plan, Lotus

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton03Subtitle
text: *You'll wait for me? All right, Lotus, let's race

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton04Subtitle
text: *I'm on my way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton05Subtitle
text: *All right, I see the POW camplooks like they have a Tunnel Network that passes under the river

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton06Subtitle
text: *Nice work, LotusTunnels down herejust take care of a couple guards and I'll have everyone freed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton07Subtitle
text: *Those vehicles would come in handy if the intel about the defenses around the mountains are correct. General, we ought to rescue them, too

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton08Subtitle
text: *General, I'm in position near the second POW Campthere's a Tunnel Network and guards out front. I could slip past them into the compound if I climbed down the cliffs on the south end of the camp

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton09Subtitle
text: *Don't get cocky, Lotus, you haven't won this race yet

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton10Subtitle
text: *That's the last of themsecond POW Camp is securedsomeone should tell Lotus to hurry upI don't want to be kept waiting at the Lab

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton11Subtitle
text: *That's some new toy. General, if you focus it at those Tunnel Networks and Stinger Sites guarding the mountain, I'll slip right by them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton12Subtitle
text: *Looks like a whole GLA base. Intel never said anything about this being here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton13Subtitle
text: *Doesn't look like they were expecting mea little C4 here and there and I'll make short work of this placejust say the word, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton14Subtitle
text: *I should be safe moving through the villagejust need to watch out for any Radar Vans monitoring the area. Wish I had a couple Flash Bangs

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton15Subtitle
text: *This is it! I'm moving into position above the Labdon't keep me waiting Lotus, its cold up here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton16Subtitle
text: *Charges setsay when, Lotus

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton17Subtitle
text: *Well, Lotus, you're fastI'll give you that. I'll be there as soon as I can

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton18Subtitle
text: *AlrightI'm at the mountainTell me when your download finishes, Lotus, and I'll bury that lab where no one will ever find it again

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat01Subtitle
text: *Garrisoneat Flash Bang

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat02Subtitle
text: *There they areremember, short controlled bursts

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat03Subtitle
text: *Infantry? No problem

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat04Subtitle
text: *We're taking firewe need some support here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin01Subtitle
text: *This is Spirit, I am rolling in over the target area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin02Subtitle
text: *Roger, Spirit, mission is go. You ready to do this?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin03Subtitle
text: *Yes, Colonel, let us begin

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin04Subtitle
text: *This is Spirit, bomb bay doors open bombs are away

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin05Subtitle
text: *Spirit to Infiltrator, your LZ is clearGood Luck

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin06Subtitle
text: *Roger, Spirit, nice shooting

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin07Subtitle
text: *On stationeverybody out who's staying

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin08Subtitle
text: *Thanks for the lift boyssee you soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin09Subtitle
text: *Your small Chinooks are efficientbut I prefer the strength of our Helixes...

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xDrvr01Subtitle
text: *We're free! Everyone to your vehicles!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xDrvr02Subtitle
text: *Thanks, General. We're at your command

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva01Subtitle
text: *General, your first objective is the destruction of this bridge. Its destruction will cut off GLA reinforcements from the other side of the river

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva02Subtitle
text: *General, GLA reinforcements have been sighted crossing the bridge

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva03Subtitle
text: *Another GLA squad has entered the area, General. Perhaps we should take care of that bridge now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva04Subtitle
text: *General, it appears that there are several GLA Radar Vans in the area, if your forces get to close, they will be detected

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva05Subtitle
text: *Excellent job, General. Now you only need to worry about GLA forces on this side of the river

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva06Subtitle
text: *The GLA have a POW camp along the route Col Burton must take to the GLA Lab. If you free the men held there, Col Burton will have an easier time getting to the Lab

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva07Subtitle
text: *General, intel suggests you free the men at the POW camp before you send Col Burton too far away

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva08Subtitle
text: *Congratulations, General, I'm sure the families of those men will be happy to hear they've been rescued

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva09Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA's Lab is directly north of your current position. There are a number of GLA defenses still along your routebe careful

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva10Subtitle
text: *It appears that those Oil Derricks are the only source of income for the GLA base. If you can destroy them you will cripple the GLA here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva11Subtitle
text: *General, I'm patching through Black Lotus

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva12Subtitle
text: *General, the men you just rescued are driving our newest vehicle, the Microwave Tank

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva13Subtitle
text: *This vehicle has two modes: The first generates a continuous microwave field in front of the vehicle - very lethal to all infantry. The second allows it to disrupt the functions of any targeted building

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva14Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA know we are here and appear to be on heightened alert. Be careful when moving Col Burton into position above their Secret Lab

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva15Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA have upgraded their tank shells to contain poisons. Be careful.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva16Subtitle
text: *I'm showing a GLA patrol in that village, Generalas well as a number of enemy forces garrisoned throughout the village

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva17Subtitle
text: *Maybe Black Lotus can find out more Intel about who is behind the GLA WMD program

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva18Subtitle
text: *That was incredible General. Looks like the GLA won't be using that facility anymoreand it seems Black Lotus downloaded some vital info about the source of this lab. For now, let's regroup and see what she was able to find out. Great work

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus01Subtitle
text: *The scorpion is disabledI will take care of matters across the river. Wait until I am across and then destroy the bridge

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus02Subtitle
text: *It is now. Don't worry, I'll wait for you at the labdo hurry

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus03Subtitle
text: *General, I am in a position to help free your forces held prisoner. Perhaps Col. Burton would like to help?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus04Subtitle
text: *General, could you ask Col Burton to please hurry to the POW campI'm tired of waiting on him

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus05Subtitle
text: *I will draw the camp guards attention to this side of the river. That should let you and your pet robots handle the Tunnel and free your captured men

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus06Subtitle
text: *Generalmy forces are moving on the final GLA positions this side of the river. Please inform Col Burton that he should hurryI would prefer not to wait too long for him to catch up

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus07Subtitle
text: *Please inform Col Burton that I shall be waiting for HIM at the Lab

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus08Subtitle
text: *I'm here, Colonelyou win. The GLA put up a stronger fight than I had anticipated. Beginning download

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus09Subtitle
text: *I have the data! Now, Colonel!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus10Subtitle
text: *General. I am ready and waiting at the Labwhenever the Colonel would like to arrive and finish this mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus11Subtitle
text: *It is cold out here. You are coming aren't you Burton?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus12Subtitle
text: *Downloading the information now

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr01Subtitle
text: *Thanks for the rescue, Sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr02Subtitle
text: *A couple of our men broke off to check out the village east of here before we were captured. They may still be over there

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr03Subtitle
text: *Good to see you, General, we thought we were going to end up captured

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr04Subtitle
text: *The rest of our team was captured just after we got to the village. General, we'd like to volunteer to rescue them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr05Subtitle
text: *General, a squad of vehicles was captured just after we were taken. The GLA are holding them in a camp just north of here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva02Subtitle
text: *Reinforcements arrived

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva07Subtitle
text: *We need to clear out these Stinger Sites before we can bring in our bombers to clear the GLA from the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva08Subtitle
text: *Construction crews have arrived sir. You'll need to get our base setup before we're overrun by the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva09Subtitle
