text: *Our final objective is this GLA base here, in the hills. Take it out, and the operation is complete

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Officer03Subtitle
text: *Terrorists detected. All units be on the alert

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Ranger01Subtitle
text: *Calling in GLA bunker location at grid square Beta Charlie 6-8-9er-4-4

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Transport01Subtitle
text: *Transport teams 1 and 2 approaching the landing zone

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Transport03Subtitle
text: *Transport Team 1 reporting! Mission completed! I'm pulling out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf01Subtitle
text: *General, intelligence reports that the rogue forces behind this GLA splinter cell are commanded by Dr. Thrax

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax is a wanted criminalresponsible for notorious terror crimes against the US military. He must be brought to justice

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf03Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax was developing a brand new toxin at his secret mountain lab. Thank goodness Lotus and Burton were there to stop him

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax is receiving his funding from his oil fields. We must cut off his flow of oil

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf05Subtitle
text: *The Intel we retrieved from the Secret Lab proves the GLA have seized these oil fields to help fund the nefarious Dr. Thrax. They may destroy them, rather then let you recapture them. Beware General, the GLA have started using Booby Trapsuse Dozers to remove BOOBY TRAPS safely

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat01Subtitle
text: *Sir! Toxin Tractors are eating us up! Send help!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat02Subtitle
text: *Toxin Tractors! Pull your infantry back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat03Subtitle
text: *Quad Cannons spotted sir!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat04Subtitle
text: *We're losing units to Quad Cannons, sir! Send armor!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat05Subtitle
text: * NO! Bravo Three was killed by a Quad Cannon, Sir!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat06Subtitle
text: *The enemy has started sending tanks, sir! Send Missile defenders!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat07Subtitle
text: *Ha! GLA tanks are no match for us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat08Subtitle
text: *Sir, we're losing units to enemy Tanks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat09Subtitle
text: *What's the enemy doing with those radar vans?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat10Subtitle
text: *Was that a car bomb?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat11Subtitle
text: *Where are those car bombs coming from?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat12Subtitle
text: *Sir, we need more defenses out here! Car Bombs are tearing us up!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat13Subtitle
text: *Bomb trucks?! That's not fair!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat14Subtitle
text: *Sir, we need better defenses against these Bomb Trucks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat15Subtitle
text: *Sir, we've engaged angry mobs! Send anti-personnel units!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat16Subtitle
text: *Angry mobs are destroying us! Send some snipers out here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat17Subtitle
text: *Sir, we need to do something about these ANGRY MOBS!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat18Subtitle
text: *Sir, we're losing units to Terrorists, can we get a sniper out here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat19Subtitle
text: *Sir, these Terrorists are chewing us up! Send support!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat20Subtitle
text: *Geez! What's with all these demo traps!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat21Subtitle
text: *Sir, this field is littered with Demo Traps! We need to clear them out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat22Subtitle
text: *What?! We've lost a structure to a CAR BOMBER!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat23Subtitle
text: *Car Bombers are attacking us! The appear to be coming from the local town

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat24Subtitle
text: *Whoa! Those bomb trucks pack a punch!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat25Subtitle
text: *Ouch! That one hurt!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat26Subtitle
text: *Sir, build more defenses to protect against the BOMB TRUCKS!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat27Subtitle
text: *Whoa! Those mobs are ANGRY!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat28Subtitle
text: *Sir, we need a Pathfinder to deal with those ANGRY MOBS!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat29Subtitle
text: *Sir, we need anti-personnel out here NOW! These angry mobs are chewing us up!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat30Subtitle
text: *Sir, we've lost a building to a car bomb

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat31Subtitle
text: *Terrorists are destroying our buildings! Call in snipers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat32Subtitle
text: *Sir! Their Bomb Trucks are destroying our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA01Subtitle
text: *Good to see some friendlies! Let's rock!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA02Subtitle
text: *Following your lead, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA03Subtitle
text: *Here I am, lead on

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin01Subtitle
text: *Satcom, this is Charlie 5. Approaching TARGET, no hostiles sightedwaitTARGET is in sight, Satcomover

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin02Subtitle
text: *Roger that 5You are a go, over

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin03Subtitle
text: *Roger Satcompayload is awayleaving hotzone! Over

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin04Subtitle
text: *Roger that 5, out. Victor 3 you are go for IMMEDIATE dropover

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin05Subtitle
text: *Roger Satcomapproaching target area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin06Subtitle
text: *Lock and Load!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin07Subtitle
text: *Jump! Jump!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin08Subtitle
text: *Careful not to get slimed, boyschem weapons sighted

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin09Subtitle
text: *This is no MILK RUN, boys! Keep your heads!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin10Subtitle
text: *Stay in formation!! No Cowboys!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin11Subtitle
text: *Goats are away. Retuning to barn. Out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin12Subtitle
text: *Bravo team, your primary objective is the small airstrip to your South. Secure it for incoming reinforcements. Out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin13Subtitle
text: *Roger Satcom, moving out. Listen up kids! This is a FREE FIRE ZONE! Watch for ROACHES! If it moves kill it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin14Subtitle
text: *Airstrip secured, GeneralReinforcements en route

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva01Subtitle
text: *The GLA has started using BOOBY-TRAPS on structures in this area. They will explode if you try to capture or garrison them. Use Dozers to remove them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva02Subtitle
text: *The GLA has seized the nearby oil fields. Protect the derricks and destroy the GLA base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva03Subtitle
text: *BE CAREFUL, General; the enemy may have set up traps in the oil field

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva04Subtitle
text: *Good news, General. Colonel Burton knows several covert operatives in this area. Lead Burton to the ops to solicit their help

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva05Subtitle
text: *Good news, General. There are several covert operatives in this area. Find them to solicit their help

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva06Subtitle
text: *Well done General, this region is now free of GLA troublemakers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva07Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. This area has been secured

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva08Subtitle
text: *General, Your ultimate objective is to destroy the GLA base in this area. Your main source of funding will be the oil derricks. You must secure and protect them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva09Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. Your mission is a success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva10Subtitle
text: *General, the local town is being poisoned by GLA propaganda and are launching attacks against us. Destroy the GLA radio station to quell the uprising

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva11Subtitle
text: *Destroy the GLA radio-station in the city to quell the uprising

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva12Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The GLA propaganda machine has been destroyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva13Subtitle
text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the car-bomb attacks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva14Subtitle
text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the bomb-truck attacks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva15Subtitle
text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the suicide attacks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva16Subtitle
text: *General, there are several ARTILLERY PLATFORMS in the area. Capture them for suppression fire

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva17Subtitle
text: *General, There is a REPAIR PAD in the area. Capture it to help heal our vehicles

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva18Subtitle
text: *Sir, please build more defenses to protect against the car bombers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva19Subtitle
text: *Sir, the enemy has started deploying Radar Vans, they can spot our pathfinders!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva20Subtitle
text: *Sir, the enemy's Radar Vans are sweeping for our pathfindersbe careful

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva21Subtitle
text: *Sir, we should build Patriots to counter the bomb trucks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva22Subtitle
text: *Sir, Enemy Terrorists are proving highly effective. I suggest you send Pathfinders

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva23Subtitle
text: *Sir! We're losing units to Demo Traps, please be more careful!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva24Subtitle
text: *General, There is an OIL REFINERY in the area. Capture it to reduce vehicle cost

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva25Subtitle
text: *Sir, the enemy has begun attacking the OIL FIELDS

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva26Subtitle
text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 1 derrick remains!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva27Subtitle
text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 5 derricks remain

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva28Subtitle
text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 10 derricks remain

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva29Subtitle
text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 15 derricks remain

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva30Subtitle
text: *General, our cash reserves are running low -- capture oil derricks for needed cash

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva31Subtitle
text: *WARNING: SCUDSTORM DETECTED!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva32Subtitle
text: *General! Colonel Burton is down!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva33Subtitle
text: *All the oil derricks have been DESTROYED! Your mission is a failure

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva34Subtitle
text: *Your base has been destroyed! Your mission is a failure

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva35Subtitle
text: *Good luck, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat01Subtitle
text: *Our base is being attacked sir. They built a tunnel network inside our base without us knowing

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat02Subtitle
text: *Those buses are loaded with hostiles sir! Watch out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat03Subtitle
text: *Our base is being attacked sir. They built a tunnel network inside our base without us knowing

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat04Subtitle
text: *We offer you our assistance to rid us of this Toxin Monger. His obsession will kill us all and that we cannot allow

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat05Subtitle
text: *Death to the Devil of Disease!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat06Subtitle
text: *Help! Over here, please release me

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat07Subtitle
text: *Thank you for releasing me. Transport me to my base in the East and I can help you

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin01Subtitle
text: *Sat-Com A4 has confirmation on base location. Visuals are uploading now

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin02Subtitle
text: *Field, please verify status of Toxin Production facilities

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin03Subtitle
text: *Then we have a go upon presentation of final clearance code

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin04Subtitle
text: *Roger that, Alpha Whiskey Echo, the birds are in the air

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin05Subtitle
text: *Toxin Production Facilities confirmed sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin06Subtitle
text: *Clearance code is Sierra, Hotel, Oscar, Charlie Kilo

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva01Subtitle
text: *Phase one of our operation has been completed General. Our Tomahawk Missile strike was successful in destroying all of GLA's Toxin production facilities. Only their main base and Toxin Missile silo's remain to be eliminated

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva02Subtitle
text: *General, we've tracked Dr. Thrax to this remote location. He is in possession of chemical tipped missiles, and has them prepped for launch. Destroying his toxin storage tanks has slowed him down, but we must move in and secure those missiles before they can be launched

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva03Subtitle
text: *General, Dr. Thrax was able to develop small quantities of his new toxin. Make sure your forces are on high alert

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva04Subtitle
text: *General, due to the civilian presence in this location you will need to use ground forces to assault the final base and capture the 4 toxin missile sites in the area. Our successful liberation of the oil sites in Amisbad has provided us with additional resources for this operation

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva05Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax must be defeated so he can't inflict further terror on the world. General, you must stop him

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva06Subtitle
text: *Our Intel indicates that this is the best area to build your base. Local unrest may be in your favor. Good luck

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva07Subtitle
text: *General, the local GLA have responded to your rescue and have given us control of their base. You may now use their forces in your attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva08Subtitle
text: *General, your main objective is to capture the 4 Toxin Missile Silo's targeted on US major metropolitan areas before they launch

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva09Subtitle
text: *General, infrared scans of the area indicate that they are preparing to launch the Toxin Missiles

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva10Subtitle
text: *Missile launch in 5 minutes Your final offensive should commence now

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva11Subtitle
text: *Missile launch in 4 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva12Subtitle
text: *Missile launch in 3 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva13Subtitle
text: *Missile launch in 2 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva14Subtitle
text: *Missile launch in 1 minute We must move in now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva15Subtitle
text: *30 seconds until missile launch It's almost too late General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva16Subtitle
text: *10 seconds until missile launch

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva17Subtitle
text: *5 4 3 2 1 (gasp) Toxin Missile Launch detected General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva18Subtitle
text: *Toxin Missile Impact has been detected and Hot Zone is now confirmed. The casualties are incalculable General, we have failed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva19Subtitle
text: *The first Missile Silo has been captured and the HazMat decontamination team is en-route. One to go Commander

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva20Subtitle
text: *Good job, sir. The second Missile Silo has been captured. Two to go

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva21Subtitle
text: *Good job, sir. The third Missile Silo has been captured. One to go

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva22Subtitle
text: *Great work, General. We now have control of all 4 Toxin Missile silo's. The operation is a success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva23Subtitle
text: *Toxin breach, you have 2 minutes to guide the Bio-engineer to the hot zone to neutralize the threat

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva24Subtitle
text: *We have a green light for the operation. Launch the attack on GLA's perimeter base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva25Subtitle
text: *Intel says that the Missile Sites we are looking for are in this region. Use caution and make sure those toxins aren't released

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva26Subtitle
text: *Infantry won't work well here, General. Our enemy is using toxins in almost every weapon that they throw at us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva27Subtitle
text: *General, your objective is to capture this structure, not destroy it! If those toxins are released then the region will be contaminated for 100 square miles!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva28Subtitle
text: *General, our intel indicates that if we can leak the napalm in those tanks into those nearby tunnels exits we can flood their whole system

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva29Subtitle
text: *Congratulations General. Dr. Thrax won't be poisoning the world with his creations any longer

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva30Subtitle
text: *Now that Dr. Thrax is defeated we can finally bring our boys home. Good work, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva31Subtitle
text: *We have a green light on Operation: Eagle's Strike. Launch the attack on Toxin Production facilities

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva32Subtitle
text: *General, your orders are to build a base to attack the Toxin General. As your forces are ready then capture the enemies 4 Toxin Missile sites before they can launch

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva33Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA base to the east has decided to Rebel against the Toxin General and his mass use of toxins. They wish to aid us in our attack against the General by giving us use of their base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva34Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has detected our presence in their main base and have begun launch preparations for the Toxin Missiles. The should have launch capability in approximately 30 minutes. Intel has located and revealed the 4 missile sites on your radar screen

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva35Subtitle
text: *General, Intel puts some of the Missiles in this region. Take care not to release the toxin!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax01Subtitle
text: *You are too late infidel, the launch is commencing to cleanse your lands in pestilence. Hahahaha

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax02Subtitle
text: *Your betrayal has not gone unnoticed. You will burn with the infidels you now assist. May your sons camels swell with virulence!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax03Subtitle
text: *My reach is long and now you will feel my wrath! Die infidel dogs, die!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader101Subtitle
text: *Enemy sighted!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader102Subtitle
text: *More GLA. Lock and load

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader202Subtitle
text: *They're too well dug in! We need reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader206Subtitle
text: *Stop those Tractors!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Officer05Subtitle
text: *Concentrate your fire, men!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader204Subtitle
text: *We've broken through to the north! Send reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader205Subtitle
text: *They're everywhere!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader301Subtitle
text: *Be advised, car bombs in the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader303Subtitle
text: *We've crossed the bridge. Sweep and clear

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader306Subtitle
text: *Heeelp!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer01Subtitle
text: *We've got to clear the area! Destroy everything!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer02Subtitle
text: *Destroy everything not American. Leave nothing behind!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer03Subtitle
text: *Copy that Delta two. Your orders are to fall back. Over

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter06Subtitle
text: *This is Echo one rolling into hot zone. Everyone keep your eyes open

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter10Subtitle
text: *Car Bomb! Car Bomb!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter12Subtitle
text: *Car bomb! Open fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter14Subtitle
text: *Alright boyslet's go!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Cin03Subtitle
text: *Looks like the whole GLA is lining up for us today

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSAChatter01Subtitle
text: *Get in formation, right now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi001Subtitle
text: *So, I see you have decided to stay and stand against me. You will regret that decision, General. Prepare to meet your end!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi002Subtitle
text: *The tiger stands poised to strike, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi003Subtitle
text: *For China! Charge!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi004Subtitle
text: *My forces are ready to engage your defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi005Subtitle
text: *Feel the stomping feet of my iron dragon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi006Subtitle
text: *Your defenses are worthless against my forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi007Subtitle
text: *Now we meet in the field of honor, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi008Subtitle
text: *This we do for the good of China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi009Subtitle
text: *It is time to test your steel, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi010Subtitle
text: *You have attacked me for the last time, General. This wave will break your defenses and crush your pitiful army to dust!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi011Subtitle
text: *The might of China falls upon you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi012Subtitle
text: *Your inferior forces will provide no challenge for my warriors

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi013Subtitle
text: *You began this fight, General. No I will finish it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi014Subtitle
text: *Attack the fool! Take no prisoners!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi015Subtitle
text: *Two warriors meet on the battlefield. Who is to say who will win? I do, that's who. Me. You will fall, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi016Subtitle
text: *A fight that cannot be won is not worth fighting. So why are you here, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi017Subtitle
text: *Rage will only get you so far, General. Now, rage and a column of tanks...that will get you somewhere

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi018Subtitle
text: *You find yourself at the end of your rope, General. And only now have you discovered that the end of that rope is on fire

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi019Subtitle
text: *The dance of battle is strange and briefand this battle with you has been strangely brief

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi020Subtitle
text: *I see you haven't thought your strategy through. Pity

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi021Subtitle
text: *That is a losing strategy, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi022Subtitle
text: *You are not acting for the good of you people, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi023Subtitle
text: *I will give you a moments pause to consider your next move

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi024Subtitle
text: *A wise man knows when to retreat. Obviously you are not such a man

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi025Subtitle
text: *In the end, all fall before me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi026Subtitle
text: *You cannot stand against my might

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi027Subtitle
text: *China cannot be defeated by one man

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi028Subtitle
text: *We shall mediate and consider our next move

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi029Subtitle
text: *Do not commit to a tactic you cannot support

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi030Subtitle
text: *Suicide is not a tactic, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi031Subtitle
text: *We sweep away your buildings like bamboo before a hurricane

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi032Subtitle
text: *Your men ran from the Barracks as we knocked it to the ground

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi033Subtitle
text: *A factory cannot produce war, General--and now your War Factory produces nothing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi034Subtitle
text: *Your Air Field has been grounded, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi035Subtitle
text: *Your base defenses fall before us like blades of grass

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi036Subtitle
text: *We've destroyed your Command Center, so where are you hiding now, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi037Subtitle
text: *So many of your buildings have fallen that I would have expected you to surrender by now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi038Subtitle
text: *Don't think you can destroy my Barracks without feeling my wraith, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi039Subtitle
text: *I'll have to rebuild that War Factory now. You would be wise to exploit my momentary weaknessit won't last

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi040Subtitle
text: *Dozers: Rebuild the Air Field before our MiGs return!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi041Subtitle
text: *Our defenses are cracking! Repel the invaders!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi042Subtitle
text: *That is quite enough destruction, General. Now it is my turn

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi043Subtitle
text: *You can claim my Command Center, but this battle isn't over, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi044Subtitle
text: *We will avenge all those MiGs you've destroyed, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi045Subtitle
text: *The price of this war is too high, General. Now it is time for you to pay

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi046Subtitle
text: *China's infantry is plentiful, but too many have been sacrificed. Now I will return your cruelty ten-fold

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi047Subtitle
text: *Capture all the oil you wish--you will not have time to reap the rewards

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi048Subtitle
text: *That Artillery Platform can easily be avoided, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi049Subtitle
text: *Seeking to increase your efficiency with that Oil Refinery, General? A solid strategy would have served you better

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi050Subtitle
text: *Something stirs at the edge of my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi051Subtitle
text: *I see you approaching my base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi052Subtitle
text: *You will not live to regret entering my base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi053Subtitle
text: *You forces may enter my base, but they will never leave again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi054Subtitle
text: *Those resources are under my protection, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi055Subtitle
text: *Why do you insist on attacking from the flanks?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi056Subtitle
text: *Interesting attack, General, but it will not succeed against me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi057Subtitle
text: *A brave attack, General, but bravery alone will not defeat me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi058Subtitle
text: *That is a fools tactic, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi059Subtitle
text: *Leave this place before you anger me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi060Subtitle
text: *I can see what you are doing, General. I will not allow it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi061Subtitle
text: *Run away from here, General, before I unleash the horde on you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi062Subtitle
text: *We are approaching your base, General. What is your defense?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi063Subtitle
text: *Are you prepared for our attack, General? We shall see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi064Subtitle
text: *Your defenses are inadequate, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi065Subtitle
text: *Now we will begin leveling your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi066Subtitle
text: *Your resources will soon be mine

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi067Subtitle
text: *I claim this Oil Derrick for China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi068Subtitle
text: *Your flanks are exposed, General. Fatal mistake

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi069Subtitle
text: *You have allowed my forces to subvert your defenses. Now we will finish you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi070Subtitle
text: *You have allowed your power to drop, General. Pray that isn't a fatal mistake

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi071Subtitle
text: *Without power you won't be able to defend your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi072Subtitle
text: *You have exhausted your resources, General. It is time to admit defeat

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi073Subtitle
text: *You have taxed my resources, General. Now I will come and take yours

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi074Subtitle
text: *The Scud Strom is a cowardly weapon, General. I thought more of you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi075Subtitle
text: *You are forcing me to answer with a Nuclear Silo of my own, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi076Subtitle
text: *That Particle Cannon is a formidable weapon, but it cannot stop China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi077Subtitle
text: *So many defensesI see you have proper respect for your enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi078Subtitle
text: *You cannot build more tanks than China, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi079Subtitle
text: *We will match you planes in the air, General. Your superiority will be only in your mind

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi080Subtitle
text: *Your men are outnumbered, General. Do not try to make a greater horde than China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi081Subtitle
text: *Your base grows large, Generalripe for a nuclear strike

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi082Subtitle
text: *Red Guard, scatter! Scud missiles inbound!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi083Subtitle
text: *We are immune to your nuclear missiles, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi084Subtitle
text: *No! Your particle beam will only injure us--we will not forget this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi085Subtitle
text: *Hide in those buildings, General. Perhaps a Dragon Tank will come to visit you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi086Subtitle
text: *Colonel Burton's exploits are legendary, but he is only one man, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi087Subtitle
text: *I see you have corrupted one of our Black Lotus agents. Her training will not turn the battle to your favor, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi088Subtitle
text: *The sniper Kell enters our battle. Do not count on his stealth to save you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi089Subtitle
text: *You are foolish to build an Air Field, General. Only tanks can save you from me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi090Subtitle
text: *You are wise to build a War Factory, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi091Subtitle
text: *That Barracks is only the beginning of what you will need to defeat me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi092Subtitle
text: *If you are going to sell your buildings, why do you bother constructing them?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi093Subtitle
text: *You will not defeat me this easily, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi094Subtitle
text: *Your advantage will not hold

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi095Subtitle
text: *I will not be beaten by the likes of you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi096Subtitle
text: *This is not the end, General. I will recover from this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi097Subtitle
text: *I must acknowledge this defeat. You have shown superior tactics, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi098Subtitle
text: *My superior tactics are leading to your defeat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi099Subtitle
text: *You are losing this battle, General. Better to accept defeat honorably than to fight on

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi100Subtitle
text: *The end is drawing near for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi101Subtitle
text: *Why do you resist the inevitable, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi102Subtitle
text: *The shadow of the dragon signals the beginning of your defeat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi103Subtitle
text: *It is time to accept your defeat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi104Subtitle
text: *It is time for the dragon to rise again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi105Subtitle
text: *There is no shame in accepting your weakness

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi106Subtitle
text: *You are not ready to face me. Return when your training is complete

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi107Subtitle
text: *Why do you run towards your own demise?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi108Subtitle
text: *This has been an interesting contest. Perhaps you will challenge me again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi109Subtitle
text: *Improve your skills and challenge me again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi110Subtitle
text: *Welcome, General. I hope you are prepared to face me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi111Subtitle
text: *Your victories speak well of your ability, but my generals did not have my cunning or experience

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi112Subtitle
text: *Soon you will see what it is to face the dragon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA001Subtitle
text: *Most enemies would have flee from the sight of my armies. Perhaps this will be worthwhile after all

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA002Subtitle
text: *My forces descend on you like the wind, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA003Subtitle
text: *Your men are like sheep before my warriors

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA004Subtitle
text: *Look at all the wonderful toys you have brought to me. I broke all my toys as a child, General, and now I will break yours

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA005Subtitle
text: *Your forces fall like wheat before my sword

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA006Subtitle
text: *You have done well against my Generals, but I have all of their power combined. What will you do against that, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA007Subtitle
text: *You will never even see my forces, Generaluntil it is too late

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA008Subtitle
text: *We will sweep you from our lands, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA009Subtitle
text: *Now you will see what your useless invasion has brought you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA010Subtitle
text: *You have dared to challenge me--now you will reap the terrible reward

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA011Subtitle
text: *How do you feel, General, as the horsemen ride to your doorstep?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA012Subtitle
text: *You've had your chance to retreat, now we will annihilate you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA013Subtitle
text: *Bear witness to the power of my will, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA014Subtitle
text: *My rage will tear your war-machine to dust

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA015Subtitle
text: *ToxinexplosivesstealthAny one of these you have defeated, but all three? All is lost, General. You should surrenderfor the good of your men

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA016Subtitle
text: *Your world has made you soft, General. Mine has made me strong

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA017Subtitle
text: *You will learn to respect my power, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA018Subtitle
text: *You will pause while I build my next attack, then the battle will resume

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA019Subtitle
text: *Have you grown tired dying against my defenses, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA020Subtitle
text: *The battlefield is quiet, General. Are you waiting for me to finish this?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA021Subtitle
text: *We await your next pathetic attack with great anticipation

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA022Subtitle
text: *Has this been the extent of your power, General? Truly pathetic

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA023Subtitle
text: *Your attacks have been like pathetic screams amidst the howl of a raging storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA024Subtitle
text: *This battle is beginning to bore me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA025Subtitle
text: *How much longer should I let you live, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA026Subtitle
text: *General, my subject require my attentionhow much longer do you intend to dance around like a clown?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA027Subtitle
text: *General, your tactics remind me of a child learning to play chess

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA028Subtitle
text: *Are you done, General? Have you exhausted your pathetic resources?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA029Subtitle
text: *General, I was bored minutes ago--now I'm beginning to fall asleep

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA030Subtitle
text: *How does it feel to challenge a true military genius?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA031Subtitle
text: *Anything you gain I will destroy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA032Subtitle
text: *Now your Barracks falls--soon all shall fall

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA033Subtitle
text: *Your War Factory is lost--rebuild it and I'll destroy it again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA034Subtitle
text: *I have relieved you of your Air Field, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA035Subtitle
text: *Your base defenses cannot stop my forces, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA036Subtitle
text: * General, if you cannot even hold on to your Command Center, how do you hope to defeat me?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA037Subtitle
text: *So many of your structures have fallen, General--why not retreat the field and spare yourself any further embarrassment?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA038Subtitle
text: *Do not test my patience further by destroying any more of my Oil Derricks, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA039Subtitle
text: *You dare to destroy my Barracks, General?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA040Subtitle
text: *General, I require an Arms Dealer to do my business. Do not destroy another one

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA041Subtitle
text: *You think to crush my defenses, General? More will rise in their place

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA042Subtitle
text: *That is the last building you will destroy, General. My patience has limits

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA043Subtitle
text: *My Command Center! You have forced me to retreat underground, but this isn't over yet, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA044Subtitle
text: *You have destroyed many of my machine, General. Perhaps I underestimated you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA045Subtitle
text: *My men are not targets for your practice, General. Their blood is on your hands

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA046Subtitle
text: *Release my Oil Derrick or I will burn it down

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA047Subtitle
text: *I see you've captured that derelict Artillery Platform. Best of luck making it work

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA048Subtitle
text: *That Oil Refinery will not turn the tide to your favor, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA049Subtitle
text: *Impudent fool! You have invaded into my home far enough

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA050Subtitle
text: *You are like a stinging insect, General, and it is time to squash your annoying presence

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA051Subtitle
text: *The enemy is in our presence! Destroy him! Destroy them all!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA052Subtitle
text: *Fool! You have crossed the line! Your forces are forfeit!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA053Subtitle
text: *Ah, a flanking attackcrude, but at least it is a strategy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA054Subtitle
text: *Attempting to attack my back-door, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA055Subtitle
text: *A frontal attack? You should have brought more forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA056Subtitle
text: *I see you've found my extra suppliesand I stress, my extra supplies. Leave them now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA057Subtitle
text: *Approaching my base from that path will only lead you to death

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA058Subtitle
text: *Stay out of that village, General. I protect those under my care

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA059Subtitle
text: *Those resources are for my people, General. They are not your for the taking

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA060Subtitle
text: *Those buildings were not placed here for your use, General. Do not disrupt my infrastructure

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA061Subtitle
text: *It seems you appetite has overstretched your resources, General. I hope you get your power back up before we reach your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA062Subtitle
text: *Our land is without powertoo bad your base cannot run without its dependence

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA063Subtitle
text: *Out of funds, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA064Subtitle
text: *General, you are taxing my resources. Your little war will cause my people to go hungry

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA065Subtitle
text: *A Scud Storm?! You have stolen our technology! You will pay for this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA066Subtitle
text: *Building nuclear weapons, General? I figured you would resort to such cowardice

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA067Subtitle
text: *Particle Cannon? Your beams from space cannot reach us beneath the earth

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA068Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses. You must truly fear my power, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA069Subtitle
text: *How many tanks do you require, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA070Subtitle
text: *You fill the air with those annoying gnats. Now we will swat them down

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA071Subtitle
text: *Train all the men you wish, General, but the loss of life will only grow greater by the minute

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA072Subtitle
text: *Your base has grown large, Generalperhaps too large

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA073Subtitle
text: *Launch your toxins at us, General; we have prepared for much worse

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA074Subtitle
text: *Everyone, underground! Their nuclear missiles approach

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA075Subtitle
text: *Yes, use your particle beam--show the world your cowardice

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA076Subtitle
text: *Garrison the building, General--hide like rats in a wall

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA077Subtitle
text: *Colonel Burton will not save you, General. You'll have to fight this war yourself

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA078Subtitle
text: *Ah, the beautiful Black Lotus. Join me, Lotus, and you could like as a queen

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA079Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell? He dares to stand against me?! My vengeance will be mostunpleasant

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA080Subtitle
text: *Your Air Field will not stand against my assault, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA081Subtitle
text: *Finally built a War Factory, eh General? What took you so long?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA082Subtitle
text: *Your pathetic Barracks will be of no use to you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA083Subtitle
text: *Selling off your buildings to fund your army? Hardly seems logical, does it, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA084Subtitle
text: *This is impossible! You cannot defeat me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA085Subtitle
text: *You may think you have the upper-hand, but this battle will turn like the wind

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA086Subtitle
text: *Your soldiers may outnumber mine now, but battles are won by more than numbers, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA087Subtitle
text: *I can't believe that I'm being beaten by such a weak-minded fool. The shame will mark me forever

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA088Subtitle
text: *Defeated by a foolthe humiliation is too great to bearplease leave me to my torment

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA089Subtitle
text: *General, I smell the stench of fear and desperation coming from you base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA090Subtitle
text: * I sense the time of your demise growing near, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA091Subtitle
text: *Your forces are beginning to be overrun, General. Soon they will be my prisoners

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA092Subtitle
text: *We are kicking you like a wounded goat, General. Admit defeat to spare your agony

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA093Subtitle
text: *You are defeated. This is what happens to all who stand against me , General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA094Subtitle
text: *You are a fool to challenge me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA095Subtitle
text: *All the powers of the GLA are at my disposal

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA096Subtitle
text: *I am more dangerous than all my three Generals combined

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA097Subtitle
text: *You have won, General. Why do you continue to torture me by examining these statistics?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA098Subtitle
text: *Yes, you can now see why you have lostthe numbers speak for themselves

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA099Subtitle
text: *You have traveled far and faced many opponents to reach me General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA100Subtitle
text: *I commend your efforts, but they have wholly unprepared you for what you are about to face

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA101Subtitle
text: *You have faced Dr. Thrax's toxic warriors; Kassad's stealth legions and Juhziz's demolitions, but I taught them all in the art of war

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA102Subtitle
text: *This will be your final battle, General. May whatever gods you pray to have mercy on youbecause I will not

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA103Subtitle
text: *This will be your final battle, General. Make your peace and prepare for the end

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA001Subtitle
text: *Well, there you are. Too late to run now, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA002Subtitle
text: *I hope you're ready, cause we're coming for ya

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA003Subtitle
text: *Set the table, Kid, cause we're coming for dinner

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA004Subtitle
text: *I've got three things to teach you, Kid: How to lose; how to cry; and how to die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA005Subtitle
text: *We're coming to attack soon, so get out all your white flags

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA006Subtitle
text: *Here we come, Kidtry not to wet yourself, okay?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA007Subtitle
text: *What part of "die" didn't you understand?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA008Subtitle
text: *Ooh, you're going to get it now, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA009Subtitle
text: *You ready? Cause here comes a tactic you may have learned in school. You ready to go back to school?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA010Subtitle
text: *It's time for me to teach you a thing or two about the back of my hand

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA011Subtitle
text: *You should have run when you had the chance. Now I'm going to teach you the meaning of respect

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA012Subtitle
text: *So, about your funeralopen casket or closed?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA013Subtitle
text: *I'm gonna march into your base and plant my foot in your butt, <sarcastic> "General."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA014Subtitle
text: *Here we come, Punk--step aside or get stepped on

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA015Subtitle
text: *You call yourself a "General"? I call you a pain in the butt, is what I call you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA016Subtitle
text: *This is your idea of strategy? Of tactics? "Tank blob" is the best you can come up with? Patheticjust pathetic

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA017Subtitle
text: *Yeah, I've read Sun Tzu too, Sport: "Greater enemy--retreat. Smaller enemy--attack." Is that all you got for me?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA018Subtitle
text: *So, where's your army, Boy? Or did you just want to bare-knuckle it? Cause I'll slap you down with my bare hands if you want. You want a piece of that, Boy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA019Subtitle
text: *You got me out of bed for this? I aught to take you over my knee right now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA020Subtitle
text: *I got more medals than you've got teeth, Boywhich won't be saying much after I get done knocking them out for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA021Subtitle
text: *Are you putting all of your defenses at the front of your base? You don't think we can go around that? Well, do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA022Subtitle
text: *Boy, you think I'm playing with you? You better think again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA023Subtitle
text: *Better check your flanks there, Partner; I think some of my troops just snuck into your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA024Subtitle
text: *Do you think this is a game? Well do you? Wait, don't answer that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA025Subtitle
text: *Kid, who taught you military tactics? Huh? Cause you should go slap him square in the mouth, I tell you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA026Subtitle
text: *I have the whole United States military behind me, Son, and I've just decided that we don't like you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA027Subtitle
text: *Is this tactic of yours supposed to be some kind of joke I'm not aware of?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA028Subtitle
text: *So, you're not a real general, are you? You're like the Surgeon General or something like that, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA029Subtitle
text: *Does your mommy know you're out by yourself?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA030Subtitle
text: *You can tell me.. We're just Generals here Do your men know you're incompetent?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA031Subtitle
text: *Did you know you just lost a Tech Building, Sport?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA032Subtitle
text: *Just blew-up your Barracks, Skippy. What you gonna do about it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA033Subtitle
text: *There goes your War Factory. You mad yet, Boy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA034Subtitle
text: *I don't know why you bothered to build that Air Field if you aren't going to protect it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA035Subtitle
text: *Who put these base defenses down like this? They can't defend anything like that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA036Subtitle
text: *I should let you build another Command Center just so I could knock it down again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA037Subtitle
text: *I feel like I'm kicking over sand castles. How many of your buildings you gonna let me destroy there, Sport?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA038Subtitle
text: *I let you have that Tech Building, Boy. I don't need it to beat you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA039Subtitle
text: *Kid, that Barracks was not a military target. Do that again and this will get ugly

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA040Subtitle
text: *You better stand down, Son--I'm not going to stand for you blowing-up my War Factories, you hear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA041Subtitle
text: *Do you know how much those jets cost? I coulda fed the whole world with what you just destroyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA042Subtitle
text: *Cracking my defenses, huh? Well, go on--it should be me just enough time to overrun your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA043Subtitle
text: *That's enough buildings, Son. Why don't you try attacking my forces now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA044Subtitle
text: *My Command Center?! You think I'm just going to sit here and take that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA045Subtitle
text: *You had best leave my pilots alone, Boy. Planes are one thing, but you let my pilots return safe, you hear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA046Subtitle
text: *You're a sneaky little 'cuss, aren't you? But I think that's enough of my vehicles destroyed, don't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA047Subtitle
text: *Let's get armor and air support out there--our grunts are getting torn apart!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA048Subtitle
text: *Let that Oil Derrick go, Boy. This war ain't about the price of gas you know

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA049Subtitle
text: *Think you know how to use that Artillery Platform, Son?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA050Subtitle
text: *That Oil Refinery is not a viable target, Son. And it don't belong to you, so we're coming to get it back

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA051Subtitle
text: *Well, you managed to get to my side of the map. Didn't think you had it in ya

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA052Subtitle
text: *You planning to attack, or you just going to stand out there all day?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA053Subtitle
text: *You'll get out of my base if you know what's good for you, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA054Subtitle
text: *Enemy's in our perimeter--all forces repel the invaders

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA055Subtitle
text: *Those ain't your supplies, Sport. Best to step-off now, before you get hurt

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA056Subtitle
text: *A flanking attack?! Don't make me laugh, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA057Subtitle
text: *Trying to attack from my back-door? Good luck with that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA058Subtitle
text: *You coming to attack me, Boy? Nice to see you have some guts

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA059Subtitle
text: *Get away from my Tech buildings, if you know what's good for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA060Subtitle
text: *My forces have your base in sight, Kid. What you gonna do now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA061Subtitle
text: *Here comes the hammer, Punk, and you don't want to be the nail

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA062Subtitle
text: *Knock-knock, we're coming in!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA063Subtitle
text: *Things are about to get real bad for you, Sport. Don't say I didn't warn you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA064Subtitle
text: *So, here's where you're hiding your resources. Mind if I take a few?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA065Subtitle
text: *You're flank's wide open, Sport

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA066Subtitle
text: *Maybe we'll come in your back-door. Whadda you think about that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA067Subtitle
text: *Look out, we're coming through the front-door!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA068Subtitle
text: *What do we have here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA069Subtitle
text: *Well, look at this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA070Subtitle
text: *What did you plan to do without power? I can't wait to see this strategy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA071Subtitle
text: *You better pay you power bill or we're going to have to postpone this fight

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA072Subtitle
text: *You're out of resources? Boy, you don't start the dance if you can't pay the bill

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA073Subtitle
text: *Uh-oh, looks like we're going to have to do some deficit spending

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA074Subtitle
text: *Built yourself a Scud Storm there? You can't hit the side of a barn with a scud, don't you know that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA075Subtitle
text: *Bringing out your nukes, huh? If Washington hadn't tied my hands, I'd show you some nukes, I tell you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA076Subtitle
text: *How'd you get a Particle Cannon, Son? That's supposed to me top-secret

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA077Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses. I can just smell the fear coming off you, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA078Subtitle
text: *Oh, look at thishere comes the tank blob. Not gonna work against me, Son

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA079Subtitle
text: *That's a lot of expensive planes you're putting in the air, Kid. Sure you wanna spend that money?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA080Subtitle
text: *Hope all those grunts know what you're getting them into

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA081Subtitle
text: *That's a lot of buildings, Son. You know that buildings can't fight for you, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA082Subtitle
text: *Bring the scuds, Punk--I'll show you the storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA083Subtitle
text: *You're going to regret nuking me, Kid. I don't take kindly to that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA084Subtitle
text: *Using a particle beam, eh? You better put me away with that cause you won't like my counter-attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA085Subtitle
text: *You know, only a coward fights from inside buildings. You know that, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA086Subtitle
text: *Welcome, Colonel Burton. Sorry you had to get tied up in this thing. No hard feelings

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA087Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus ain't your salvation, Boy. She ain't gonna get anywhere near my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA088Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell's just another sniper, Punk. I've got dozens of snipers

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA089Subtitle
text: *Yeah, build your Air Field--get some birds in the air. May be your only shot a stopping me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA090Subtitle
text: *Only one War Factory? It's gonna take at least half-a-dozen to stop me, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA091Subtitle
text: *Is that Barracks a little close to the front-lines, Kid? Hard to sleep with bullets in your barracks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA092Subtitle
text: *Don't just sell one building, Boy--sell them all and hope that I don't come for you anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA093Subtitle
text: *Don't get cocky, Boy--this ain't over yet

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA094Subtitle
text: *You may think you have the upper-hand, but I've got a few tricks left in me. You'll see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA095Subtitle
text: *I've dug myself outta worse holes than this, Punk. You ain't gonna win that easily

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA096Subtitle
text: *You think you're beating me? You best think again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA097Subtitle
text: *HuhI guess it's over. Nice work, Kid. I guess you took me down a peg or two

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA098Subtitle
text: *Can you feel my fist starting to close around your neck, Punk?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA099Subtitle
text: *Don't take losing to me so hard--everyone loses to me, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA100Subtitle
text: *Give me a sec to get some tanks together and I'll end this little skirmish

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA101Subtitle
text: *Why don't you just give up now, <sarcastic> "General."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA102Subtitle
text: *Boy, I beat you like an old drum. Who gave you a command? Cause I've got some word for them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA103Subtitle
text: *Don't click that button unless you're serious, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA104Subtitle
text: *You wanna tangle with me? I think you better think again, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA105Subtitle
text: *Don't bring that attitude in here unless you can back it up, Punk

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA106Subtitle
text: *Show me what you got

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA107Subtitle
text: *Maybe you could make a few extra bucks polishing my boots, cause you sure ain't no general

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA108Subtitle
text: *Good work, General. I salute you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA109Subtitle
text: *I ain't gonna give no speeches, so let's just get this on

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo001Subtitle
text: *I have some surprises for you, General. Why don't you come out and play?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo002Subtitle
text: *Now that the field is covered with explosives, I suppose we'll attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo003Subtitle
text: *General, I have a delivery for yousign for it, won't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo004Subtitle
text: *Careful, who knows when Jarmen Kell will sneak into your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo005Subtitle
text: *Did your building just blow up? HmmI wonder how that happened?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo006Subtitle
text: *All of my forces are packed with explosives, General. I wouldn't shoot at them if I were you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo007Subtitle
text: *My Terrorists have learned to disguise themselves asoops, have I said too much?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo008Subtitle
text: *You might notice that my explosives pack a bit more punchI hope you appreciate our attention to quality

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo009Subtitle
text: *Look how quickly the Scud Launcher destroys a building nowjust wait, it's amazing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo010Subtitle
text: *First, all is silencethen "boom!"ahhdon't you just love it, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo011Subtitle
text: *I rarely attack, you should feel honored

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo012Subtitle
text: *Here comes another attack, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo013Subtitle
text: *My troops are coming to assault your basemake them feel welcome

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo014Subtitle
text: *Please ignore my workers, General; they're just burying someummgarbage for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo015Subtitle
text: *Oh, General, you must see thisit's the bomb. <childish laugh>

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo016Subtitle
text: *We're going out for more explosives, General. Be right back

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo017Subtitle
text: *It's quiet out there, General. You know what quiet means, right? BOOM!!!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo018Subtitle
text: *I am the master of explosives, General. You have no defense against me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo019Subtitle
text: *Your base has been targeted for demolition

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo020Subtitle
text: *Do you fear my next attack, General? You should

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo021Subtitle
text: *As we speak my agents are sneaking into your base and planting explosives

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo022Subtitle
text: *Your building could be wired to explode right now. You'll never know until it's too late

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo023Subtitle
text: *There are few units that can detect my demolitionsdo you know which ones they are?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo024Subtitle
text: *Demo Traps are difficult to construct, General. To appreciate their beauty you have to see one up close

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo025Subtitle
text: *How are you enjoying my tricks and traps so far?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo026Subtitle
text: *Awwyour Tech Building went boom

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo027Subtitle
text: *We've destroyed your BarracksI hope no one was in there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo028Subtitle
text: *Your War Factory has fallen, General. Build another one so we can knock it down again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo029Subtitle
text: *Air Fields are so fragile--it's hardly even fun to destroy them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo030Subtitle
text: *Your base defenses cannot take my explosives, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo031Subtitle
text: *Ah, there's nothing quite like destroying a Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo032Subtitle
text: *We've destroyed so many of your buildings, GeneralI appreciate you building more for our ammusement

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo033Subtitle
text: *You've destroyed our Oil Derrick. Now you're getting into the spirit of things

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo034Subtitle
text: *My Barracks! Many of my demolitions were in there, General. I'll make you pay for this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo035Subtitle
text: *Not my War Factory! General, this annoy habit you've developed cannot continue

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo036Subtitle
text: *Not to worry, my base defenses are only an early-warning signal. Now you must walk through my true defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo037Subtitle
text: *Too many! You've destroy too many of my structures, General. Now the fighting gets dirty

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo038Subtitle
text: *We will rebuild that Command Center, General, and you will play for this transgression

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo039Subtitle
text: *General, how do you expect me to defeat you if you keep destroying my vehicles?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo040Subtitle
text: *You're cutting my men down before they can place their demolitionsthat doesn't seem right, does it, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo041Subtitle
text: *Ah yes, capture that Oil Derrick, General. Then we'll have more to destroy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo042Subtitle
text: *General, why do you want that Artillery Platform?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo043Subtitle
text: *Good, General, capture the Oil Refinerythey blow-up so dramatically

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo044Subtitle
text: *Be careful, General--your men have just enter the danger zone around my base. Even I don't remember where all the traps are set out there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo045Subtitle
text: *General, your men are coming dangerously close to my base. I'd turn back if I were you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo046Subtitle
text: *Get out of my base, General. This whole area is wired with explosives, and I'm not afraid to use them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo047Subtitle
text: *You fool! Do you know how many explosives are surrounding your men right now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo048Subtitle
text: *Attacking from the flank, General? There might be few defenses there, but what about traps?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo049Subtitle
text: *The back of my base is particularly nasty, General. I wouldn't recommend an assault from there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo050Subtitle
text: *A frontal assault?! You are more of a fool than I thought, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo051Subtitle
text: *There is nothing in this valley for you except death

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo052Subtitle
text: *Careful, General; this looks like a good place for an ambushoops, too late

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo053Subtitle
text: *You think I didn't prepare for you coming here, General? Fool

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo054Subtitle
text: *Those are my resources, General. Go find your own

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo055Subtitle
text: *General, you've entered my demolitions storage facility. One false move and we all die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo056Subtitle
text: *Ah, I see we hit one of your power lines. I hope your power isn't out for too long

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo057Subtitle
text: *Your dependency on electricity will be you undoing, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo058Subtitle
text: *Your resources are exhausted, General. My forces are circling for the kill

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo059Subtitle
text: *My resources are low, General. Mind if we come take some of yours?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo060Subtitle
text: *A Scud StormI seeWell, perhaps it is time to build one of my own

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo061Subtitle
text: *I wonder how many explosives it will take to destroy that Nuclear Silo?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo062Subtitle
text: *Now why do you want to build a Particle Cannon? We were just beginning to have fun, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo063Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses, General. How do you expect my bombers to enter your base now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo064Subtitle
text: *Tanksso many tanks. I'll enjoy watching your tanks hit my traps, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo065Subtitle
text: *Stop building planes, Generalyou'll miss the genius of my traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo066Subtitle
text: *With that many infantry you're sure to set-off my Demo Traps. I'd tell them to spread out when crossing the field, Generalor not

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo067Subtitle
text: *So many buildings Your base is a perfect target for my explosives, General. Thank you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo068Subtitle
text: *Foolish move, General. Your Scud Storm won't stop me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo069Subtitle
text: *Nuclear missile! You will pay for this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo070Subtitle
text: *No! That particle beam will set off my explosives!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo071Subtitle
text: *Yes, garrison that building, General--it probably doesn't have explosives attached to it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo072Subtitle
text: *Hello, Colonel Burton. Try not to step on any traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo073Subtitle
text: *Black Lotusjust because you can detect my traps do not think I am now vulnerable

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo074Subtitle
text: *Why would you send Jarmen Kell against me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo075Subtitle
text: *Do not build any more Air Fields, GeneralI don't like them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo076Subtitle
text: *The War Factory builds vehiclesvehicles that will set-off my Demo Traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo077Subtitle
text: *Do you think it is wise to build a Barracks, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo078Subtitle
text: *Please, General, don't sell-off what I could destroy for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo079Subtitle
text: *General, you're not playing fair. Now go step on some traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo080Subtitle
text: *You're exceptionally lucky, General, but you can't avoid my Demo Traps forever

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo081Subtitle
text: *No one has beaten my traps, General, and you won't be the firstyou'll see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo082Subtitle
text: *Do you think you're beating me, General? This could change in an instant--I don't fight fair

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo083Subtitle
text: *You may have defeated me, General, but Deathstrike will avenge me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo084Subtitle
text: *Ha ha! Your troops are falling to my traps, General. Soon they'll all be gone

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo085Subtitle
text: *You're losing, General. My tactics elude you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo086Subtitle
text: *You'll never defeat me, General. You should leave before you get hurt

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo087Subtitle
text: *I have so many explosives leftmore explosives than you have forces I'm afraid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo088Subtitle
text: *You lose, General. Too bad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo089Subtitle
text: *I have just the thing. Let's go make war

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo090Subtitle
text: *Demolitions expert: How can I help you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo091Subtitle
text: *I wonder if I could wire that button to explode?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo092Subtitle
text: *Please, General--enter my battlefieldbut watch where to step

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo093Subtitle
text: *You were lucky this time, General. You could never beat me again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo094Subtitle
text: *You were not prepared for this kind of war. Try again, if you dare

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo095Subtitle
text: *Here we see the battlefield--openuntouched by battlea blank slate for our little...

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo096Subtitle
text: *Now where did those Demo Traps come from?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo097Subtitle
text: *Perhaps I have a few cards hidden up my sleeve, but did you except any less from me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger001Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, you ever seen a Raptor up close?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger002Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, did you see that Stealth Fighter?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger003Subtitle
text: *Birds' away! Let's go hunt some dozers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger004Subtitle
text: *I'm done playing with you, General. (Announcing to his own forces) Everyone attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger005Subtitle
text: *Will you look at thatUS military spending at its best

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger006Subtitle
text: *(Singingbadly)and the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger007Subtitle
text: *Here comes the rain of terror, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger008Subtitle
text: *How are you enjoying the Shock-and-Awe, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger009Subtitle
text: *Death from above!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger010Subtitle
text: *It doesn't seem fair, does it, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger011Subtitle
text: *It's time to pull the goalies. Everyone attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger012Subtitle
text: *Bombs away!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger013Subtitle
text: *It's awfully quiet out thereyou didn't leave did you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger014Subtitle
text: *Don't worry, General, this is just the quiet before the storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger015Subtitle
text: *I'd take this break to rebuild your defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger016Subtitle
text: *Shhdid you hear that? I wouldn't worry, it's probably nothing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger017Subtitle
text: *Sorry, General, we're just taking a lunch-break-be with you in a minute

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger018Subtitle
text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger019Subtitle
text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger020Subtitle
text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger021Subtitle
text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger022Subtitle
text: *Ouch, that must have been expensive

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger023Subtitle
text: *Huh, where are you going to train your troops now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger024Subtitle
text: *Having trouble keeping up those defenses, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger025Subtitle
text: *You've lost a lot of buildings, General; were you planning on using harsh language now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger026Subtitle
text: *Dozers, start repairing our buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger027Subtitle
text: *I'll get you for this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger028Subtitle
text: *You'll regret destroying that airfield, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger029Subtitle
text: *Dozers, rebuild our defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger030Subtitle
text: *This is General Granger to Aircraft Carrier Olympia: Send reinforcementsrepeat: send reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger031Subtitle
text: *They're attacking the Command Center! All forces, regroup!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger032Subtitle
text: *I don't appreciate you shooting down my planes, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger033Subtitle
text: *They're taking over our Oil Derricks! Rangers, get out there and take them back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger034Subtitle
text: *Get out of our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger035Subtitle
text: *Get out of my airspace, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger036Subtitle
text: *The enemy's in our perimeter! All planes return to base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger037Subtitle
text: *Ground forces, defend the airfields!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger038Subtitle
text: *You're not stealing my supplies, are you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger039Subtitle
text: *They're coming in the back-door!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger040Subtitle
text: *Hiding in the village, huh. That's a coward's tactic, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger041Subtitle
text: *Stop hiding, General. Don't make me come and get you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger042Subtitle
text: *They're at the East gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger043Subtitle
text: *Defend the East side!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger044Subtitle
text: *Enemy forces approaching the West gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger045Subtitle
text: *All forces to the West gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger046Subtitle
text: *Having trouble keeping your power up, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger047Subtitle
text: *Oops, your power's down - here come the bombs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger048Subtitle
text: *Out of resources, General? Want to borrow some?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger049Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, how 'bout we call this one a draw?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger050Subtitle
text: *You may have won the battle, General, but the war is far from over

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger051Subtitle
text: *So, you built a Scud Storm. Think you can defend it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger052Subtitle
text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General Think it will be enough to calm the fear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger053Subtitle
text: *Your tanks are no match for my planes, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger054Subtitle
text: *Anthrax! Everyone find cover!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger055Subtitle
text: *Garrison all the buildings you want, General-it won't help

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger056Subtitle
text: *How much more of this can you take, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger057Subtitle
text: *Ready to surrender yet?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger058Subtitle
text: *Haven't you lost enough troops, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger059Subtitle
text: *This battle is over, General-surrender or prepare to die!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger060Subtitle
text: *Not going to surrender, huh? Too bad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger061Subtitle
text: *Bombs away, punk

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger062Subtitle
text: *Come on, General--I'll show you the meaning of "Death from Above."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger063Subtitle
text: *Sonic-boom, baby. Let's do this thing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger064Subtitle
text: *I guess it's time for me to go find a good airline job

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger065Subtitle
text: *I win--you lose. What more is there to say?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger066Subtitle
text: *Be advised: This area is under the control of Air Force General Malcolm Granger. Withdraw now or prepare to be bombed back to the stone-age

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger067Subtitle
text: *General, you're no match for me--I own the skies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger068Subtitle
text: *Watch the skies, General; we're going to put on an air-show

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger069Subtitle
text: *Wanna see it again?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger070Subtitle
text: *Ready-or-not, here I come!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger071Subtitle
text: *You don't mind if we drop-in, do ya General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger072Subtitle
text: *That's two of my airfields you've hit, General. I'm starting to get annoyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger073Subtitle
text: *Curse you, General. If you hit another airfield I'll come for you personally

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger074Subtitle
text: *That's the last airfield you destroy today. (Announcing to his own troops) Forces, target their Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger075Subtitle
text: *I can't believe you beat me, General. I salute your superior tactics

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger076Subtitle
text: *It looks like you defeated me this time, General, but we'll meet again someday and I won't be so merciful because-

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger077Subtitle
text: *I thought he'd never shut up

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger078Subtitle
text: *You don't think I'm going to let you keep that Scud Storm, do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger079Subtitle
text: *Another Scud Storm? I guess it's time to take the up a notch

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger080Subtitle
text: *Pilots, watch-out for those Stinger Sites

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger081Subtitle
text: *So many Rangers-so few buildings to capture

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger082Subtitle
text: *General, do ya know how a Fuel-Air Bomb works? How 'bout a demonstration?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger083Subtitle
text: *Welcome to the party, Colonel Burton. You're in for it now, General
