label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger084Subtitle
text: *Do you know how to stop an A-10, General? Me neither

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger085Subtitle
text: *Hey, wanna see our new Bunker Buster?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger086Subtitle
text: *Artillery! You think you can attack me with artillery?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger087Subtitle
text: *You know that Scud Launcher is never going to make it to my base, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger088Subtitle
text: *Wait, that's a Bomb Truck! Everyone look out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger089Subtitle
text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger090Subtitle
text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger091Subtitle
text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger092Subtitle
text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger093Subtitle
text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry001Subtitle
text: *So, this is where you're hiding, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry002Subtitle
text: *<sarcastic>Feeling overwhelmed General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry003Subtitle
text: *(Chinese infantry troops die) <angry voice> 1 billion more where that came from

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry004Subtitle
text: *(Paradrop)Like a swarm of locusts they descend from the sky to devour all those who stand against China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry005Subtitle
text: *Ever been hacked General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry006Subtitle
text: *<shouting>March!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry007Subtitle
text: *They make good shields too

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry008Subtitle
text: *Here's a tip General, Surrender!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry009Subtitle
text: *Don't worry General, we don't take prisoners

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry010Subtitle
text: *Unleash Horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry011Subtitle
text: *It's ok General, we've brought our own flag for your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry012Subtitle
text: *Soon all your men will see are boots marching over them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry013Subtitle
text: *Charge!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry014Subtitle
text: *Death to all who oppose us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry015Subtitle
text: *Do you know how hard it is to feed a horde, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry016Subtitle
text: *I have enough men to hold a parade. Can we have it in your base?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry017Subtitle
text: *Are you still here, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry018Subtitle
text: *Are you just going to sit there and wait to be overrun?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry019Subtitle
text: *Are your resources getting low, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry020Subtitle
text: *How long does it take for you to build your little tank force?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry021Subtitle
text: *<sarcastic> What tactic will you amaze me with now, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry022Subtitle
text: *This can't be the best you can do, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry023Subtitle
text: *So far I'm not impressed, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry024Subtitle
text: *You were not prepared for this challenge, were you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry025Subtitle
text: *I have enough men to crush you without firing a shot

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry026Subtitle
text: *We are coming for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry027Subtitle
text: *Awwwe've knocked over your little Tech Building. Boo-hoo

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry028Subtitle
text: *Now your Barracks is gone. How will you fight without men?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry029Subtitle
text: *Without a War Factory you'll have to fight me man-to-man, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry030Subtitle
text: *No more planes for you. Get on the ground and fight like a man

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry031Subtitle
text: *My men are marching right through you base defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry032Subtitle
text: *There is only empty ground where your Command Center once stood, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry033Subtitle
text: *I have lost many men, General, but the cost to your buildings has been worth it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry034Subtitle
text: *Leave my Tech Buildings alone, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry035Subtitle
text: *NO! Not my Barracks! We will build another, Generalthen you will pay

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry036Subtitle
text: *My War Factory is not essential to my victory, but do not destroy another

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry037Subtitle
text: *You have destroyed my Air Field! This is getting annoying, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry038Subtitle
text: *Destroy all the base defenses you want--they're only there to slow you down anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry039Subtitle
text: *You have cost me many buildings, General. My men are coming to collect repayment

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry040Subtitle
text: *Nooo! They destroyed my Command Center! Go get them! Keep them away from me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry041Subtitle
text: *Swat all the planes you like, General--we'll make more

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry042Subtitle
text: *My vehicles are not for your target practice, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry043Subtitle
text: *There are many more in my army ready to sacrifice for China, General. You won't stop us

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry044Subtitle
text: *I see you've captured my Oil Derrick, General. We are coming to take back China's oil now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry045Subtitle
text: *That old Artillery Platform is destroyed, General; you'll never get it to work

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry046Subtitle
text: *Do you think that Oil Refinery is just there for anyone to use? Return the refinery to me now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry047Subtitle
text: *Get any closer to my base and I'll set the horde out on you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry048Subtitle
text: *I warn you, General, get away from my base. Do you know what a hundred men can do to a tank?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry049Subtitle
text: *They're in our base! Kill them! Get them out of here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry050Subtitle
text: *They're getting too close! Protect me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry051Subtitle
text: *General, get away from my resources--my men need those

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry052Subtitle
text: *General, do not try to flank my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry053Subtitle
text: *A back-door attack will not help you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry054Subtitle
text: *Attacking the front of my base is foolish, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry055Subtitle
text: *Those are my Tech Buildings, General. Stay away

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry056Subtitle
text: *Get out of my buildings, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry057Subtitle
text: *Crossing that bridge is a mistake, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry058Subtitle
text: *You've run out of power, General--your defenses are down and my men will invade soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry059Subtitle
text: *Without power you'll never stop my horde, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry060Subtitle
text: *You've wasted all your resources fighting my menbut I still have more men

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry061Subtitle
text: *We are out of resources! How did this happen?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry062Subtitle
text: *Build your Scud Storm--it will only hit a few of my menthe rest will destroy you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry063Subtitle
text: *I thought nuclear missile were not allowed! This is hardly fair, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry064Subtitle
text: *That Particle Cannon is useless against my horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry065Subtitle
text: *Yes, you should build more base defenses--at least then you can stop the first wave of the charging horde

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry066Subtitle
text: *Coward! You know that your tanks cannot crush my men, don't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry067Subtitle
text: *So many planesno matter, my horde and bring down your planes too

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry068Subtitle
text: *You're mobilizing a horde of your own?! You will need many more men to match my strength, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry069Subtitle
text: *You base has grown too large, General. It is time for my men to drop in and capture a few for China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry070Subtitle
text: *Scud Storm! Scatter!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry071Subtitle
text: *Nuclear missile approaching! Flee! Get me out of here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry072Subtitle
text: *Ooh, look at the pretty light show. What do you hope to accomplish with that petty weapon, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry073Subtitle
text: *Get out of that building, General. We have ways of bringing you out by force if necessary

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry074Subtitle
text: *You've brought Colonel Burton to our little war, General. Even he will fall when faced with the horde

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry075Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus? How will she help you survive my horde, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry076Subtitle
text: *All forces beware: Jarmen Kell is hiding in the field

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry077Subtitle
text: *I see that Air Field, General. Run to the air! Fear my horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry078Subtitle
text: *My men will tear your tanks apart as fast as you can make them, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry079Subtitle
text: *My men are trained in groups of threehow fast can you train your men?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry080Subtitle
text: *Selling your buildings? Foolish! What will you buy with the money to stop my horde?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry081Subtitle
text: *I have so many forces, how can you be winning this battle?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry082Subtitle
text: *I have underestimated your tactics, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry083Subtitle
text: *You've caught me off guard, General, but now I am ready for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry084Subtitle
text: *You will not defeat my horde, General! Your current advantage will soon be lost

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry085Subtitle
text: *I do not accept this defeat, General. My men will cover my escape and we will fight another day

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry086Subtitle
text: *My men outnumber you now, General. I would be wise to surrender

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry087Subtitle
text: *This looks like the end for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry088Subtitle
text: *If you do not retreat now I will unleash the horde to scrape you from our land

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry089Subtitle
text: *Do you feel the end drawing near, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry090Subtitle
text: *Haha! I have defeated you. Now you must choose to join my horde or die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry091Subtitle
text: *It is time to unleash the horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry092Subtitle
text: *Face me and fall like the rest

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry093Subtitle
text: *My men will crush you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry094Subtitle
text: *We will tear through you like locusts

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry095Subtitle
text: *Men? Where are my men? You wouldn't consider letting me go would you? Please don't hurt me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry096Subtitle
text: *We have nice uniforms in the hordeit won't be so badyou might even like it. But I doubt it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry097Subtitle
text: *Are you ready to face my horde, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry098Subtitle
text: *And think, this is just the first wave

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser001Subtitle
text: *I have you in my sights now, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser002Subtitle
text: *Precision attack commencing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser003Subtitle
text: * (player units destroyed) Interesting choice of tactics, they didn't help my last opponent either

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser004Subtitle
text: *I'm about to attack, I thought you could use the warning

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser005Subtitle
text: *Maybe you should re-evaluate your strategies, they obviously don't work

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser006Subtitle
text: *How do you like my new toys General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser007Subtitle
text: *Prepare yourself General, you're about to be taught a lesson in war

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser008Subtitle
text: *Easy come, easy go

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser009Subtitle
text: *Maybe you're not cut out for this, try painting

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser010Subtitle
text: *Beautiful aren't they General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser011Subtitle
text: *My lasers will cut through your defenses like a hot knife through butter

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser012Subtitle
text: *Checkmate

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser013Subtitle
text: *It's a whole new age of warfare, General, and it's coming to your doorstep

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser014Subtitle
text: *Target is painted--all forces begin attack run

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser015Subtitle
text: *Originally all my weapons also had laser targeting, but my enemies got confused

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser016Subtitle
text: *Don't look directly at the laser--you could burn-out the back of your head

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser017Subtitle
text: *Charging lasersplease wait, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser018Subtitle
text: *Lasers must be calibrated precisely for maximum effect

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser019Subtitle
text: *Dozers, build more Reactors--lasers take a lot of power

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser020Subtitle
text: *Can you match fifty million mega-joules of lasing power, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser021Subtitle
text: *Looks like a big space battle, doesn't it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser022Subtitle
text: *My lasers are going to turn your armor to vapor

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser023Subtitle
text: *General, you should really try to coordinate your attacks--this has been all to easy for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser024Subtitle
text: *Don't get distracted by the pretty lights, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser025Subtitle
text: *Would you like me to "beam you up," General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser026Subtitle
text: *Your weapons can't match my pinpoint accuracy, General. Why not just surrender?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser027Subtitle
text: *Why don't you build another Barracks, General? I'll enjoy destroying that one too

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser028Subtitle
text: *If you can't protect your War Factory, how safe could your Command Center be?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser029Subtitle
text: *Your planes are not safe from my lasers, especially without your Air Field

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser030Subtitle
text: *Your base defenses are worthless against me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser031Subtitle
text: *Ah, the Command Center--queen of this chessboard. This match is all but over now, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser032Subtitle
text: *My lasers have destroyed so many of your buildingshow do you keep fighting?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser033Subtitle
text: *General, don't destroy my Tech Buildings, I need those

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser034Subtitle
text: *Get away from my Barracks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser035Subtitle
text: *My War Factory! Noooo!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser036Subtitle
text: *How dare you destroy my Air Field!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser037Subtitle
text: *They're destroying our defenses! All forces: defend the base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser038Subtitle
text: *General, these losses are unacceptable. I'll repay you for destroying my buildings

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser039Subtitle
text: *No! Quickly, Dozers rebuild the Command Center!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser040Subtitle
text: *General, if you bring down any more of my planes I'll use all my Super Weapons to destroy you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser041Subtitle
text: *Leave my vehicles alone, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser042Subtitle
text: *You're hunting my men on purpose, aren't you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser043Subtitle
text: *Reap the rewards from that Oil Derrick while you can; we'll be there to take it soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser044Subtitle
text: *That Artillery Platform is no match for my airborne lasers

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser045Subtitle
text: *Did you know that that Oil Refinery will let you build vehicles faster and more efficiently? Oops, I probably shouldn't have told you that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser046Subtitle
text: *You've tripped our outer perimeter warning lasers, General. We know you're there now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser047Subtitle
text: *I see you approaching my base, General. I wouldn't advise coming any closer

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser048Subtitle
text: *The enemy is in our base! All forces return and deploy lasers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser049Subtitle
text: *Get away from my Reactors, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser050Subtitle
text: *General, those resources are for me--stay away from them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser051Subtitle
text: *Attacking from the flanks, eh? It will take more than tactical tricks to beat me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser052Subtitle
text: *Flanking attacks?! You are devious, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser053Subtitle
text: *Yes, come straight through my front-door, Generalif you dare

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser054Subtitle
text: *Be careful, General--the back-door of my base isn't so undefended as it seems

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser055Subtitle
text: *You are foolish to come here, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser056Subtitle
text: *These resources are not enough to save your failed strategy, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser057Subtitle
text: *No! Stay away! I need those reactors to power my lasers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser058Subtitle
text: *Out of power?! How could you let your base run out of power?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser059Subtitle
text: *Running out of power is a fatal mistake, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser060Subtitle
text: *You're out of resources, General. You'll never recover before we overrun you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser061Subtitle
text: *Out of resources?! This is unacceptable! Chinooks, gather faster!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser062Subtitle
text: *Sell that Scud Storm, General, or I'll destroy it for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser063Subtitle
text: *That Nuke Silo won't stop me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser064Subtitle
text: *If you build a Particle Cannon and I destroy it with a Particle Beamis that irony?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser065Subtitle
text: *That excessive amount of base defenses will only slow down my laser, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser066Subtitle
text: *Your conventional tanks are no match for my laser based weapons platforms, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser067Subtitle
text: *That's quite a lot of planes, General. Are you putting on an air show?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser068Subtitle
text: *Quite a few infantry you've trained there, General. I can't wait to see this crazy plan

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser069Subtitle
text: *Your base is starting to look like a housing tract, General. Maybe I should play some connect-the-dots with the Particle Cannon to thin your numbers a bit

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser070Subtitle
text: *I will shoot those scud missiles down, General. Then you will pay

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser071Subtitle
text: *My lasers will bring that nuke down, General. The fallout will be on your hands

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser072Subtitle
text: *Particle Cannon?! I wonder what would happen if we crossed the beams

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser073Subtitle
text: *General, don't garrison that building; come out and play

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser074Subtitle
text: *General, Colonel Burton is a bumbling fool

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser075Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus is not invisible to my lasers, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser076Subtitle
text: *I hope Jarmen Kell isn't using a laser scope on his rifleit wouldn't work against me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser077Subtitle
text: *Building an Air Field only provides airborne targets for my lasers, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser078Subtitle
text: *You're going to need a lot of tanks to get to me, General. Good luck

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser079Subtitle
text: *Building a Barracks will only get your men hurt, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser080Subtitle
text: *Selling off your structures eh? That the first mistake of a desperate general

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser081Subtitle
text: *What?! You can't be beating me! Your lack of precision alone should ensure my victory

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser082Subtitle
text: *I can't lose to you--you're a bumbling buffoon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser083Subtitle
text: *How can you be winning? This isn't how it played out in the simulation

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser084Subtitle
text: *I've calculated every variable, yet you're winninghow is this possible?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser085Subtitle
text: *No! This can't be the end! What trickery did you use to beat me?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser086Subtitle
text: *My planning a preparation is leading me to a clear victory

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser087Subtitle
text: *Precision will always defeat brute force, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser088Subtitle
text: *This must be like a nightmare for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser089Subtitle
text: *Have you decided how you are going to accept this defeat, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser090Subtitle
text: *You are defeated, General. But then that was never really in question, was it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser091Subtitle
text: *Lasers charged--tracking targets now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser092Subtitle
text: *You're not in my class, General--try an easier opponent

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser093Subtitle
text: *I calculate that you will lose this battle, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser094Subtitle
text: *Lasers make superior weapons

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser095Subtitle
text: *You defeated me, General, but I will scan your tactics and devise a superior strategy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser096Subtitle
text: *Your weaknesses became obvious when I scanned your tactics

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser097Subtitle
text: *There you go, General--I've drawn the line in the sand

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser098Subtitle
text: *Now I dare you to cross it. Come and get me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke001Subtitle
text: *At least it's a dry heat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke002Subtitle
text: *Soon your base will glow like the sun

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke003Subtitle
text: *How do you expect to fight this, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke004Subtitle
text: *Your weapons are no match for my power!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke005Subtitle
text: *Melt! Everything must melt!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke006Subtitle
text: * The glow! The wonderful glow! Can't you see it, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke007Subtitle
text: *It looks like a nuclear winter this year, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke008Subtitle
text: *The end is near, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke009Subtitle
text: *This is only the beginning, General. The beginning of the end

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke010Subtitle
text: *Don't worry, General, the warheads are on their way

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke011Subtitle
text: *Sorry for the delay, General; just gathering my forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke012Subtitle
text: *Is the heat getting to you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke013Subtitle
text: *Having a meltdown, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke014Subtitle
text: *All forces, prepare for the next assault

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke015Subtitle
text: *Now where did I put those launch codes?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke016Subtitle
text: *Are you ready for more, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke017Subtitle
text: *I think this is your half-life, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke018Subtitle
text: *I hope your radar isn't down, General; I'd hate for you to miss what's coming next

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke019Subtitle
text: *I know your weaknesses now, General. The next attack will be unstoppable

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke020Subtitle
text: *Soon you will know the glory of my nuclear arsenal

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke021Subtitle
text: *I'd stock up on sun-block if I were you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke023Subtitle
text: *Eventually someone must win the arms race, or what's the point of racing?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke024Subtitle
text: *Time to put on the lead underwear

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke025Subtitle
text: *Remember: Don't look directly at the blast, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke026Subtitle
text: *It appears you have only trained your men to die, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke027Subtitle
text: *Now your War Factory is a glow crater. Wonderful

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke028Subtitle
text: *Your defenses crack like so many eggshells, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke029Subtitle
text: *Oh, you weren't in that Command Center, were you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke030Subtitle
text: *Why do you destroy my barracks, General? It isn't my men you should fear

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke031Subtitle
text: *My War Factory! What have you done?! My precious tanksgone...

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke032Subtitle
text: *Leave me alone! What have I ever done to you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke033Subtitle
text: *My Command Center! No!!! I won't lose command! I won't!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke034Subtitle
text: *I can't believe you are beating me! Perhaps you would give me a moment to rebuild?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke035Subtitle
text: *We have suffered great loses at your hands, General, but this isn't over yet

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke036Subtitle
text: *General, you can have that oil derrick, but it won't help you stop me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke037Subtitle
text: *Get out of my base, General! I won't ask twice

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke038Subtitle
text: *How long were you planning on stay in my base, General? Should I prepare a bunk for you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke039Subtitle
text: *Leave my base, General, or I will be forced detonate my warheads

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke040Subtitle
text: *Do you like my village, General? Please, make yourself at home

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke041Subtitle
text: *Coming to inspect the nukes, General? You can look, but don't touch

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke042Subtitle
text: *I'd be careful, General; these nuclear depots tend to leak

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke043Subtitle
text: *Get away from my supplies, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke044Subtitle
text: *General, I wouldn't capture that oil derrick if I were you--I'll only destroy it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke045Subtitle
text: *Get away from my silos, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke046Subtitle
text: *I see your power is down, General. Should I send you some nuclear energy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke047Subtitle
text: *Out of funds already? Don't you know war is expensive, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke048Subtitle
text: *Please, build more tanks, General; even they will melteventually

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke049Subtitle
text: *Keep those planes away from my silos!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke050Subtitle
text: *So many soldiers, General. Do they have their radiation suits on?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke051Subtitle
text: *How many nukes do you think it will take me to destroy that new weapon, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke052Subtitle
text: *How many nukes do you think it will take me to destroy that new weapon, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke053Subtitle
text: *Selling off buildings? General, if you wanted to clear that area I could have done it for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke054Subtitle
text: *You cannot stand against my might, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke055Subtitle
text: *Surrender! Or do you want the bombing will continue?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke056Subtitle
text: *You are losing this war, General. A few more bombs and your base will fall!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke057Subtitle
text: *Might makes right. Wouldn't you agree, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke058Subtitle
text: *And now for my final attack. Hold on, General, you're going to like thiswait, no you won't

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke059Subtitle
text: *None will stand against our nuclear arsenal

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke060Subtitle
text: *Challenge me and your base will glow like the sun

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke061Subtitle
text: *Soon you'll be nothing more than nuclear waste

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke062Subtitle
text: *Another moment and I would have reduced you to dust

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke063Subtitle
text: *You are lucky to have survived this battle intact. Challenge me again if you dare

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke064Subtitle
text: *Welcome to the party, General. Please excuse the mess

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke065Subtitle
text: *Now, General, I think you understand why I am known as Mao the Nuke

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke066Subtitle
text: *We've been waiting for you, General. Please accept our gifts

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke067Subtitle
text: *More gifts, General. Our generosity is limitless

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke068Subtitle
text: *Now the battle begins in earnest. Prepare yourself, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke069Subtitle
text: *Cold fusion is no way to create power, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke070Subtitle
text: *It pains me to destroy your reactors, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke071Subtitle
text: *You call that a "super weapon", General? It breaks like a toy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke072Subtitle
text: *No! My warheads! My beautiful warheads! You will pay, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke073Subtitle
text: *That's okay, General, I have more nukes for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke074Subtitle
text: *Hey, do you know how much that nuke silo costs?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke075Subtitle
text: *Okay, General, that's enough--I'm running out of nukes!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke076Subtitle
text: *Why do you want to blow-up my nukes anyway, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke077Subtitle
text: *No! That was my last nuclear silo! Why, General..why?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke078Subtitle
text: *(enemy lost all silo) You have destroyed all of my siloswhy, General? Why?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke079Subtitle
text: *(enemy caps player barracks) I've captured your barracks, General. Perhaps I will sell it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke080Subtitle
text: *(enemy caps player war factory) My men have captured your War Factory. You really should have guarded it better

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke081Subtitle
text: *(player base) Your defenses are weak, General; we have entered you base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke082Subtitle
text: *(combat zone) My forces are in the field, General. Soon they will roll into your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke083Subtitle
text: *(supply dock area) Ah, we've found some supplies. Soon we will control all of the resources!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke084Subtitle
text: *(second supply dock area) More supplies for us. How are you funding your troops, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke085Subtitle
text: *(oil derrick area) Red Guard--capture that oil derrick!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke086Subtitle
text: *It appears we have used all the supplies in the area. I hope you've made other arrangements, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke087Subtitle
text: *(enemy out of power) What?! I'm out of power? How can I be out of power? Someone get me more power! Now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke088Subtitle
text: *(ambulance) That ambulance will not save your men from the radiation

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke089Subtitle
text: *(strat center) A Strategy Center? What strategy could you possibly devise to fight me?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke090Subtitle
text: *(black market) The Black Market won't sell you anything powerful enough to stop me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke091Subtitle
text: *(propaganda center) Your propaganda will not turn anyone against my nuclear power, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke092Subtitle
text: *Oh, look--I have a nuke ready for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke093Subtitle
text: *Wow, two nukes! I am pleased

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke094Subtitle
text: *Three nukes?!? That's three times the fun!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke095Subtitle
text: *Four nukes? Incredible!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke096Subtitle
text: *Five nukes? Maybe you want me to send you a clean pair of shorts now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke097Subtitle
text: *(player sells building) General, if you sell off any more buildings I'll win by default

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth001Subtitle
text: *Look at what I've found

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth002Subtitle
text: *Here comes my next attacktry to be ready this time, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth003Subtitle
text: *You can't kill what you can't see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth004Subtitle
text: *You didn't need those troops anyways

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth005Subtitle
text: *Sleeping on the job again?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth006Subtitle
text: *hanks for the new units. They'll prove useful in destroying you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth007Subtitle
text: *Watch this! Oh wait, you can't

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth008Subtitle
text: *Did you bring your thermal goggles?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth009Subtitle
text: *I think it's time to acquire a new base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth010Subtitle
text: *It was never meant to be General. Good bye!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth011Subtitle
text: *Closing your eyes will not make the pain of defeat any easier

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth012Subtitle
text: *My stealth assassins will make short work of your forces, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth013Subtitle
text: *We will strike like the snake--quick and invisible

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth014Subtitle
text: *You will not stand against this attack, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth015Subtitle
text: *Handsome Generals always win battles

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth016Subtitle
text: *You'll never see me until it is too late , General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth017Subtitle
text: *General, perhaps you could introduce me to Black Lotus. I'm a great admirer of heruh, work

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth018Subtitle
text: *When it is quiet you should fear me the most

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth019Subtitle
text: *I can't wait for your next attack, General. Can we expect it today?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth020Subtitle
text: *Don't let your senses grow dull, General--you can expect my attack any moment now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth021Subtitle
text: *You can't defeat me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth022Subtitle
text: *I will attack when you least expect it, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth023Subtitle
text: *My men are all over the battlefield, General...hidden from viewready to strike

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth024Subtitle
text: *Stealth is my allyand your enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth025Subtitle
text: *You've lost your Tech Building, General. What shall you lose next?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth026Subtitle
text: *You could not stop me from destroying you Barracks, General. What do you value if not your men?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth027Subtitle
text: *Destroying you War Factory was child's-play. Your Command Center can't be far behind

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth028Subtitle
text: *Your planes have lost their Air Field, and you have lost your advantage, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth029Subtitle
text: *There is a hole in your defenses now, General. Who can say how many of my men are in your base now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth030Subtitle
text: *Your Command Center is gone, General. My victory is all but assured

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth031Subtitle
text: *I don't relish destroying your buildings, General, but you leave me no choice

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth032Subtitle
text: *You are targeting my Tech Buildings because you have no hope of reaching my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth033Subtitle
text: *You have destroyed my Barracks, but we will rebuild and those men will be avenged

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth034Subtitle
text: *My Arms Dealer will not be pleased that you destroyed his depot, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth035Subtitle
text: *You have destroyed that base defense, General, but that just may have allowed my men time to out-flank you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth036Subtitle
text: *You've destroyed many of my buildings, but with even one factory left I am a dangerous opponent, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth037Subtitle
text: *Nicely played, General; you've destroyed my Command Center. Now I will be forced to fight dirty

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth038Subtitle
text: *You're quite adept at discovering my camouflaged vehicles, General. I'll consider a new tactic

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth039Subtitle
text: *Your brutish tactics are costing me men, General. I'll reconsider my tactics now that I know you have none

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth040Subtitle
text: *Now that I've captured this Oil Derrick, my forces will grow even faster

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth041Subtitle
text: *Artillery Platforms are so brutish, but I can't let you have it, can I?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth042Subtitle
text: *This Oil Refinery is now mine, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth043Subtitle
text: *General, you are coming dangerously close to my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth044Subtitle
text: *I see forces approaching my base, General. You don't mean to invade do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth045Subtitle
text: *You are testing my patience, General. Remove you forces from my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth046Subtitle
text: *If you do not remove your forces from my base, I'll remove them permanently

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth047Subtitle
text: *So you're trying to enter my base from the flank. We'll put a stop to that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth048Subtitle
text: *A back-door attack? I didn't realize you were so devious, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth049Subtitle
text: *A frontal assault? That will prove a fatal mistake, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth050Subtitle
text: *Those are my resources, General--go find your own

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth051Subtitle
text: *Why do you insist on approaching my base that way, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth052Subtitle
text: *That route is not as unguarded as it seems, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth053Subtitle
text: *The only thing you will find here is your own destruction, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth054Subtitle
text: *What is your fascination with this area, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth055Subtitle
text: *We are nearing your base, General. There may be cross-hairs on your head right now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth056Subtitle
text: *Your outer defenses are weak, General. Let's hope you base is better protected

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth057Subtitle
text: *We have entered you base, General. Ignore us at your own peril

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth058Subtitle
text: *Your defenses are broken, General. How will you repel us now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth059Subtitle
text: *You really should be defending these resources, General, or this battle will be very short

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth060Subtitle
text: *I've found your Tech Buildings, General. What should I do with them?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth061Subtitle
text: *I've found the back-door to your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth062Subtitle
text: *Can you defend against my flanking attack, General? Let's find out

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth063Subtitle
text: *Only a careless general would allow the power to fail

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth064Subtitle
text: *Your power is down, General. You did not plan your infrastructure properly. Let's hope it isn't a fatal mistake

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth065Subtitle
text: *General, you can't fight without resources. What will you do now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth066Subtitle
text: *You have robbed me of my resources, General. Now I will return the favor

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth067Subtitle
text: *So, you have built a Scud Storm. We will have to deal with this new threat

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth068Subtitle
text: *Nuclear weapons have no place in this battle, General. Why do you insist on building them?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth069Subtitle
text: *You would strike at me from space with your cowardly Particle Cannon? I am disappointed, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth070Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses, General. What are you afraid of?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth071Subtitle
text: *You're building tanks, are you. Well, a few more sniper should take care of that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth072Subtitle
text: *More planes? Why so many, General? Afraid to come down and face me?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth073Subtitle
text: *Let me give you some advice, General. That large group of infantry is no match for my snipers

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth074Subtitle
text: *Your base has grown so large, General. Do you think you can defend all your buildings from capture?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth075Subtitle
text: *You've launched! You'll regret using that Scud Storm, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth076Subtitle
text: *Nuclear missiles! I thought you were bluffing, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth077Subtitle
text: *Yes, look at the cowardly particle beam. Enjoy this, General--my answer will be swift and brutal

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth078Subtitle
text: *By all means, General, garrison that buildingmy snipers can possibly hit them in there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth079Subtitle
text: *Colonel Burton, General? Perhaps you should make him the general; you'll only lead him to an early grave

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth080Subtitle
text: *Ah the beautiful Black Lotus. Perhaps after you're defeated, General, she'll agree to join me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth081Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell?! All snipers beware: Jarmen Kell has entered the field

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth082Subtitle
text: *Wise choice, building an Air Field, but planes alone will not be enough to defeat me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth083Subtitle
text: *My spies tell me you've finally built your War Factory, General. Are you ready to fight now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth084Subtitle
text: *Train all the men you wish from that Barracks, General; they are no match for my snipers

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth085Subtitle
text: *You've sold-off one of your buildings. Such tactics lead to defeat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth086Subtitle
text: *How are you defeating my forces?! It's not possible!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth087Subtitle
text: *You may have the upper-hand now, but your desperate tactics will not endure, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth088Subtitle
text: *My forces will rise up against your oppression and we will defeat you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth089Subtitle
text: *Enjoy your advantage for now, Generalyou'll make a mistake soon and I'll turn the tide of this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth090Subtitle
text: *So it endsyou've defeated me, General, but someday I'll have my revenge. Watch your back, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth091Subtitle
text: *Your forces are weakening, General. Accept defeat and I'll go easy on you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth092Subtitle
text: *Your attacks are ineffective against me, General. Soon we'll sweep in and destroy you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth093Subtitle
text: *I'm enjoying this little game, General, but your pathetic attacks are beginning to bore me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth094Subtitle
text: *I thought you would provide more of a challenge, General. I guess I overestimated you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth095Subtitle
text: *You have fallen to Kassad, like all have before you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth096Subtitle
text: *We will strike like the snake--unseen and deadly

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth097Subtitle
text: *Now you see me--now you're dead

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth098Subtitle
text: *I am Kassad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth099Subtitle
text: *This will not go well for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth100Subtitle
text: *My men will not accept this defeat from their leader, General. You have signed my death warrant with your superior tactics

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth101Subtitle
text: *Accept your bitter defeat and remove yourself from my sight, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth102Subtitle
text: *And another who stood against me falls

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth103Subtitle
text: *And so it will be for you, General--no warning, no mercy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth104Subtitle
text: *You still have time to flee with your life, General. <evil laughter trailing off to silence>

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank001Subtitle
text: *I see you haven't run in fear, General. Soon you'll wish you had

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank002Subtitle
text: *My forces are at your door, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank003Subtitle
text: *The iron dragon marches through your puny defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank004Subtitle
text: *I fear this will end you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank005Subtitle
text: *Mmmcan you feel the thunderous song of approaching armor, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank006Subtitle
text: *Are you protecting your flanks, General? Why don't we have a look

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank007Subtitle
text: *Are you impressed with the modifications to my tanks, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank008Subtitle
text: *Armor...crush them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank009Subtitle
text: *Soon, the field will fill with tanksmy tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank010Subtitle
text: *All units...attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank011Subtitle
text: *Nice base, Generalcare to surrender it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank012Subtitle
text: *This spells your doom, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank013Subtitle
text: *We're in your base, General; your defenses were inadequate

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank014Subtitle
text: *You dare attack my War Factory! All forces, remove this pest!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank015Subtitle
text: *Tanksbuild more tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank016Subtitle
text: *Another battalion is on its way, General, please make them feel welcome

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank017Subtitle
text: *Ah, this is the part of the battle I enjoy the mostthe part just before I finish off my enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank018Subtitle
text: *Tanks: move fasterbefore our opponent considers an actual attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank019Subtitle
text: *It's quiet out there, General. There must be a lot of tanks rolling towards your base, don't you think?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank020Subtitle
text: *I'm going to take this time to construct more defensesno, wait, I'll build more tanks instead

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank021Subtitle
text: *This area was once fertile farm land. Soon your blood will make it fertile again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank022Subtitle
text: *Your tactics amuse me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank023Subtitle
text: *Enjoy the rest, General--soon the attacks will begin again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank024Subtitle
text: *We're awaiting your assault, General, but I'm beginning to wonder if it will ever come

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank025Subtitle
text: *Our War Factories are working hard to make more tanks, just for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank026Subtitle
text: *How much longer can you survive such loses, General? Perhaps it is time to consider surrender

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank027Subtitle
text: *Tanks amass in our base, preparing for the final assault. Will your defenses hold this time?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank028Subtitle
text: *Soon we will remove you from our lands

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank029Subtitle
text: *This will be your last chance to prove yourself, General. Soon my tanks will end your pitiful army

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank030Subtitle
text: *You cannot believe your luck will hold out much longercan you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank031Subtitle
text: *You didn't want that Tech Building, did you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank032Subtitle
text: *Your Barracks has fallen to my tanks, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank033Subtitle
text: *There goes your factory, General. How will you match my armor now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank034Subtitle
text: *Without your airfield you've lost your only chance against me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank035Subtitle
text: *Your defenses fall like toys before my armor

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank036Subtitle
text: *You can't lost your Command Center and all hope to win against me, General. I await your surrender

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank037Subtitle
text: *You've lost a lot of buildings, Generalisn't it time to surrender?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank038Subtitle
text: *That tech building was mine, General; you will regret destroying it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank039Subtitle
text: *So, you've destroyed my Barracks--so be it. Now I will destroy yours

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank040Subtitle
text: *We will rebuild that War Factory. Soon the tanks will again flow to your base like water

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank041Subtitle
text: *Destroying my Airfield will not stop me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank042Subtitle
text: *Destroying my defenses only let's me know where you are, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank043Subtitle
text: *General, you are destroying an unacceptable number of my buildings. This must stop

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank044Subtitle
text: *You've destroyed my Command CenterI am impressed, General...few survive this long

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank045Subtitle
text: *You're shooting at my planes?! Do you think this is the best tactic against me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank046Subtitle
text: *Enough! Do not destroy any more of my tanks, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank047Subtitle
text: *Stop targeting my infantry, you coward!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank048Subtitle
text: *General, I need that Oil Derrick for my tanks. Release it to me or pay

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank049Subtitle
text: *That Artillery Platform is no match for my armor, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank050Subtitle
text: *Ah, I see you captured an Oil Refinery. Perhaps I should take it from you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank051Subtitle
text: *We are approaching you base, General. Prepare yourself

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank052Subtitle
text: *Ah, my tanks are almost in range of your base. This should be over soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank053Subtitle
text: *We've breached your defenses, General. Now your factories will begin to fall

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank054Subtitle
text: *Thank you for inviting us into your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank055Subtitle
text: *I see your flank is exposed, General. I expected as much

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank056Subtitle
text: *There are no guards at your backdoor--a fatal mistake on your part, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank057Subtitle
text: *I see you've built a second base, General. It will soon be removed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank058Subtitle
text: *Ah, I've found your Tech Building. Now, should I destroy it or capture it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank059Subtitle
text: *Your power is down--your forces are finished

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank060Subtitle
text: *I would suggest restoring your power, Generalbefore we turn it off permanently

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank061Subtitle
text: *Your supply pile looks lownow nothing can stop us

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank062Subtitle
text: *Supplies! I need more supplies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank063Subtitle
text: *And what you plan to do with that Scud Storm, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank064Subtitle
text: *And now this war has gone nuclearexcellent

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank065Subtitle
text: *That Particle Cannon will never live to fire on me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank066Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses, Generalall so useless

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank067Subtitle
text: *So, you're trying to match my tanks in the field. I question your tactics, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank068Subtitle
text: *I see many planes, General--like gnats waiting to be swatted out of the sky

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank069Subtitle
text: *You have trained too many men, General; they will all be crushed beneath my treads

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank070Subtitle
text: *Your base has grown too large, General--my tanks will enjoy the target practice

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank071Subtitle
text: *Your Scud Storm will harm us, but now you have made me angry, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank072Subtitle
text: *Only a failed General would resort to nuclear missiles

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank073Subtitle
text: *This particle beam will not defeat us, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank074Subtitle
text: *Yes, garrison your buildings--you only delay the inevitable

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank075Subtitle
text: *No one soldier can turn the tide, not even Colonel Burton

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank076Subtitle
text: *Ah, Black Lotus, you grace us with your presence. Perhaps you would consider fighting for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank077Subtitle
text: *All tanks beware: Jarmen Kell has entered the field

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank078Subtitle
text: *An Air Field is a wise choice against me, but it won't save you from defeat, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank079Subtitle
text: *Build your War Factories, General; they still will not produce tanks capable of stopping mine

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank080Subtitle
text: *I see you've built a Barracks, General. Please, try to keep your men out from under my tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank081Subtitle
text: *Yes, sell all of your buildings and flee from the field, General. This battle is lost to you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank082Subtitle
text: *You are losing, General. This battle is mine

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank083Subtitle
text: *All hope is gone now, General. Surrender or die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank084Subtitle
text: *General, my forces outnumber yoursit is only a matter to time now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank085Subtitle
text: *Your inferior strategy has lead you to this place, General. You can't win now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank086Subtitle
text: *My victory was assured from the beginning

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank087Subtitle
text: *Your tactics have given you a momentary advantage,General, but you won't maintain it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank088Subtitle
text: *No! You will not win, General. We will build more tanks and defeat you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank089Subtitle
text: *Your cowardly tactics may have gotten you this far, but this foolishness ends now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank090Subtitle
text: *I think I've let you win long enough, General. Prepare for the end

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank091Subtitle
text: *Arrrrrgh! This cannot be! How have you defeated my tanks?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank092Subtitle
text: *Time to unleash the war machine

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank093Subtitle
text: *Your tank rush is nothing compared to mine

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank094Subtitle
text: *Don't challenge my tanks, General--you will lose

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank095Subtitle
text: *My armor will crush your pathetic forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank096Subtitle
text: *You may have defeated my tanks, General, but the Tigress will crush you like an insect

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank097Subtitle
text: *Tanks are the key to any victory, as you well know

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank098Subtitle
text: *I see you defeated my scouts, General. The next attack won't go so well for you, I think

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank099Subtitle
text: *Here we come, General, I hope your defenses are up

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank100Subtitle
text: *And these are just my Battlemasters, Generaljust wait until the Overlord join the battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank101Subtitle
text: *I'd be careful, General, sometimes the Red Guard like to take over buildings while you're busy with my tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin001Subtitle
text: *I see you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin002Subtitle
text: *One taste, and you'll never go back -- even if you wanted to!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin003Subtitle
text: *Have a taste of my own medicine!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin004Subtitle
text: *How long can you hold your breath?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin005Subtitle
text: *Ready for another chemistry lesson?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin006Subtitle
text: *It's not so bad. You should only feel a long and painful burning after this!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin007Subtitle
text: *Toxin troopers, attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin008Subtitle
text: *Here we come, General, like a chemical spill

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin009Subtitle
text: *It's so hard to find a doctor that makes housecalls, but Dr. Thrax does

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin010Subtitle
text: *Spill on isle one!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin011Subtitle
text: *Like acid rain, we decend upon your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin012Subtitle
text: *Go forth, my toxic warriors! Bring our message to the masses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin013Subtitle
text: *Oh, you're going to like this, General. No, waitno you won't

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin014Subtitle
text: *You've brought this on yourself, General. Now watch your men pay for your mistake

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin015Subtitle
text: *Silent but deadly

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin016Subtitle
text: *That's right -- sit back and relax! Give my toxins more time to work!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin017Subtitle
text: *The suspense it's killing you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin018Subtitle
text: *Time to brew another batch!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin019Subtitle
text: *Every moment you delay, you die a little bit more!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin020Subtitle
text: *You can tell they're just right when the flesh falls off the bone!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin021Subtitle
text: *Anthrax it does a body bad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin022Subtitle
text: *Smell that? No?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin023Subtitle
text: *And breathe in out and again feel better?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin024Subtitle
text: *Good to the last drop!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin025Subtitle
text: *I'll give you a "breather" before our next attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin026Subtitle
text: *We have a clogged toxin nozzle, Generalgive me a second to fix it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin027Subtitle
text: *You'll come for the toxin, but you'll staybecause you're dead!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin028Subtitle
text: *You will regret intruding on my experiments, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin029Subtitle
text: *Are you going to attack me, or are you afraid of what you might find at my base, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin030Subtitle
text: *Nothing can live beneath my toxic cloud, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin031Subtitle
text: *You didn't really need that anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin032Subtitle
text: *Your troops appear intoxicated, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin033Subtitle
text: *Ohh general, looks like your troops can't hold their toxin

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin034Subtitle
text: *Your Air Field is destroyed, General. Now you'll have to walk through my clouds of death

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin035Subtitle
text: *Notice how the toxins tear everything apart?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin036Subtitle
text: *Argh! I had my wine collection in there!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin037Subtitle
text: *My toxins and your troops certainly have chemistry!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin038Subtitle
text: *I didn't need that anyway!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin039Subtitle
text: *Now where will my chemical soldiers come from?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin040Subtitle
text: *My toxin trucks will roll again!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin041Subtitle
text: *See, people don't belong in the air

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin042Subtitle
text: *You inconvenience me, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin043Subtitle
text: *Stop destroying my buildings, General, or I will make thingsunpleasant for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin044Subtitle
text: *You've destroyed my Command Center! Ah well, I always hated my commanders anywaynow it's just you and me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin045Subtitle
text: *General, if you keep destroying my vehicles, how can I bring you your medicine?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin046Subtitle
text: *My brave warriors! How can you do this to them? What did they ever do to-- oh wait, never mind

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin047Subtitle
text: *Give that Oil Derrick back! Don't you know petroleum is a key ingredient in my toxins?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin048Subtitle
text: *That Artillery Platform will not stop me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin049Subtitle
text: *General, I need that Refinery to purify my toxins. What could you possibly need it for?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin050Subtitle
text: *Did I give you permission to come in?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin051Subtitle
text: *What are you doing in here? The recipes are mine!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin052Subtitle
text: *You are a fool to come into my base, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin053Subtitle
text: *You are too close to my precious toxins, General. Now you must die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin054Subtitle
text: *Stay away from my scud missiles! I'll give them to you when I'm ready!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin055Subtitle
text: *I don't think you want those supplies, they aren't  ready yet

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin056Subtitle
text: *I see you're building another base. Soon it will be abandoned

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin057Subtitle
text: *Get out of my village, General. There's not much left of it, but it is mine!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin058Subtitle
text: *Be careful as you cross that bridge, General--the water below isn't safe for swimming

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin059Subtitle
text: *Watch out, General, that bridge might not be safebut then, what is around here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin060Subtitle
text: *Do you think you're being clever, sneaking in my backdoor?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin061Subtitle
text: *So, you've made it across the river. Now the battle gets interesting

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin062Subtitle
text: *It looks like you're out of power, General. Perhaps I should attack now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin063Subtitle
text: *You're out of power, General. It's time for me to come and play

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin064Subtitle
text: *Your resource pile has grown small,General. I don't think you have enough left to stop my next attackexcellent

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin065Subtitle
text: *Budget?! I don't want to hear about the budget!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin066Subtitle
text: *You dare to build a Scud Storm in my presence! You know, of course, that we are all immune to its toxins, right, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin067Subtitle
text: *A Nuke Silo? I would not have expected you to use toxic radiationperhaps we could work together sometime

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin068Subtitle
text: *So, a Particle Cannon to counter my toxins, eh? Your technology is no match for my toxins, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin069Subtitle
text: *So many defenses, General. ALL USELESS!!!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin070Subtitle
text: *Metal is only a temporary barrier to my toxins!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin071Subtitle
text: *Ah -- coward! Your pilots still need to breathe!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin072Subtitle
text: *Do you enjoy seeing your men glow in the dark? Build more, then!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin073Subtitle
text: *Your base has grown large, Generala perfect target for my Scud Storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin074Subtitle
text: *Yes, fire your Scud Stormvisit your useless toxins upon my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin075Subtitle
text: *Your nuclear missile will only mutate us and make us stronger, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin076Subtitle
text: *You cannot hope to clear my toxins with that particle beam, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin077Subtitle
text: *Yes, garrison that building--I'm sure my Toxin Tractors will love that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin078Subtitle
text: *If you bring Colonel Burton into this I'll have to release Jarmen Kell

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin079Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus? You know, of course, that the black lotus is a poisonous flowerI think that's in one of my toxinsbut I digress

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin080Subtitle
text: *I see Jarmen Kell has joined our little war. Perhaps mine would enjoy a sniper duel

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin081Subtitle
text: *Now what do you want with that Air Field, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin082Subtitle
text: *So our General builds a War Factory. How predictable of you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin083Subtitle
text: *Yeeesss, build a Barracks--send you men to me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin084Subtitle
text: *Sell off allyour buildings, Generaland send your men to me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin085Subtitle
text: *Give up now, and I guarantee you'll breathe easy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin086Subtitle
text: *Your troops are short of breath, General. Give up!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin087Subtitle
text: *My second wind spells your doom, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin088Subtitle
text: *Let me drown your sorrows with a nice toxin!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin089Subtitle
text: *Toxic Fatality

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin090Subtitle
text: *You are defeated, General. Perhaps this will teach you to defy Dr. Thrax

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin091Subtitle
text: *Would you consider a peace offering? An antidote, perhaps?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin092Subtitle
text: *Perhaps I've inhaled too many of my own toxins--You can't possibly be defeating me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin093Subtitle
text: *Get away from me! You will not defeat me, General. Do you hear me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin094Subtitle
text: *What do you have against toxins? Have you seen what they put in food these days?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin095Subtitle
text: *Even if you defeat me, my toxins will get to you -- eventually!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin096Subtitle
text: *No! No. I am defeated. Now where is that cyanide capsule

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin097Subtitle
text: *That button was covered with poisonyou're already dead

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin098Subtitle
text: *You dare select Dr. Thrax? You should reconsider, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin099Subtitle
text: *You cannot defeat my toxins, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin100Subtitle
text: *Perhaps I shouldn't have gotten my degree from a mail-order college

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin101Subtitle
text: *You thought my toxins were ineffective and now look what has happened to you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin102Subtitle
text: *Hello, General. Do not think I cannot see your spies flying over my base. Please, look all you wish, because this may be the last time you ever see my stronghold

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin103Subtitle
text: *As you can see, my defenses are impenetrable...and my toxic weapon systems will poison your troops long before they can reach me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin104Subtitle
text: *And do not worry about hurting the civilian population, General; they have long since fled this valley of toxic death. Our little war will play-out uninterruptedand your delicate sensibilities will not be taxed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin105Subtitle
text: *Ah yes, and here is where you've placed your pathetic base. Now make your stand against me--Dr. Thrax--and once your forces have breathed their last breath of my toxic air, I can return to my experiments

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin106Subtitle
text: *Do you trust your senses, General? By engaging me, you have doomed yourself to a long and painful death, for I am Dr. Thrax, and my weapons strike unseen!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin107Subtitle
text: *Breathe easy, General, for I am Dr. Thrax, and with every breath you take, you are on your way to defeat!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin108Subtitle
text: *The first sample is free!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin109Subtitle
text: *Would you like the green or the blue? Both are equally satisfying!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin110Subtitle
text: *Prepare to tell your 3-eyed grandchildren of your defeat this day!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin111Subtitle
text: *My precious chemicals! Do you know how long it takes to mix those?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin112Subtitle
text: *More victi- ah- volunteers for my experiments!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin113Subtitle
text: *Now I have more vehicles to ferry my toxins! So generous of you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin114Subtitle
text: *Oh, did I forget to tell you about those? Watch the mines, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin115Subtitle
text: *Now where did I put those chemical troops?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin117Subtitle
text: *Bah! You!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin118Subtitle
text: *Ah yes, and here is where you've placed your pathetic base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle001Subtitle
text: *Oh, you're still here, General. I'm impressed by your determination. Let's dance

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle002Subtitle
text: *That didn't hurt too much, did it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle003Subtitle
text: *The battlefield is a rough place, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle004Subtitle
text: *Another perfectly executed strike

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle005Subtitle
text: *It's all going according to plan

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle006Subtitle
text: *Everything seems to be going my way

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle007Subtitle
text: *How does that feel, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle008Subtitle
text: *Tactical superiority is key, General. Here, let me show you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle009Subtitle
text: *I really don't think you're going to be able to stop this next attackdo you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle010Subtitle
text: *Here comes another attackoh, and almost all of my Generals Powers are ready to gowhich one do you want to see first?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle011Subtitle
text: *Is that my Superweapon ready to go? Oh no, my attacks just feel like that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle012Subtitle
text: *All units: Attack pattern alpha! Just kiddingwho would call something "alpha"?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle013Subtitle
text: *Here comes some of my units, General. Would you mind helping them gain some veterancy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle014Subtitle
text: *I rarely send in the troops, but you deserve special attention, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle015Subtitle
text: *I warn you not to underestimate me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle016Subtitle
text: *You may think I'm hiding, but I'm really just planning

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle017Subtitle
text: *Fools rush in, General. I take my time

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle018Subtitle
text: *You don't know what to expect from me, do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle019Subtitle
text: *If you fail to plan, you plan to fail, General. Think about it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle020Subtitle
text: *My greatest "super weapon" is my brainwouldn't you agree, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle021Subtitle
text: *Come on, General, take your best shot

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle022Subtitle
text: *We're waiting for you, General. What's keeping you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle023Subtitle
text: *I've been analyzing you tactics and I'm just amazeddo you even have any tactics, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle024Subtitle
text: *I'd attack if I were you, General. If you wait then I'll just have one more Superweapon to fire at you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle025Subtitle
text: *So, your over-all strategy is to bore me off the battlefield?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle026Subtitle
text: *Are you rethinking the wisdom of attacking me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle027Subtitle
text: *I've been trying to go easy on you, General, but you're starting to annoy me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle028Subtitle
text: *This has been fun, General, but I think it's time to end this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle029Subtitle
text: *Maybe we should do this some other timewhen you're not so distractedat least, I hope that's what's wrong. You did say you were a "general", right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle030Subtitle
text: *You weren't using that, were you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle031Subtitle
text: *I didn't like the look of that Barracks, at all

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle032Subtitle
text: *Your vehicles are getting on my nerves

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle033Subtitle
text: *Stay out of the air, General--you'll be safer on the ground

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle034Subtitle
text: *Was that supposed to keep me out of your base, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle035Subtitle
text: *Wow, you just lost your Command Center. That's not very good, is it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle036Subtitle
text: *Your base was much too cluttered before

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle037Subtitle
text: *You have no respect for other people's property!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle038Subtitle
text: *People, who was supposed to be guarding the Barracks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle039Subtitle
text: *I was using that War Factory!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle040Subtitle
text: *Is keeping my air field too much to ask

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle041Subtitle
text: *I put that there for a reason!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle042Subtitle
text: *I had just gotten all of those buildings where I wanted them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle043Subtitle
text: *I don't appreciate that kind of disrespect!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle044Subtitle
text: *I built all of those planes for a reason!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle045Subtitle
text: *Destroy as many vehicles as you like. See if I care

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle046Subtitle
text: *How dare you hurt my soldiers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle047Subtitle
text: *I let you have that one

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle048Subtitle
text: *I didn't need that anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle049Subtitle
text: *Capturing the Refinery? Why, General, I didn't know you were so efficiency conscious

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle050Subtitle
text: *Who invited you here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle051Subtitle
text: *I don't think you have the right security clearance to be here

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle052Subtitle
text: *What gives you the right to be in my base?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle053Subtitle
text: *This is my base, get out now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle054Subtitle
text: *Don't expect me to be a good hostess

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle055Subtitle
text: *I don't like unexpected visitors, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle056Subtitle
text: *What do you think you're doing here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle057Subtitle
text: *Intruders!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle058Subtitle
text: *Your presence is starting to bother me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle059Subtitle
text: *Who was supposed to be guarding that area?!?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle060Subtitle
text: *So you've managed to crack my defensesthat won't happen again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle061Subtitle
text: *Get out of my base, General. Don't think I'm above dropping the Particle Cannon right here

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle062Subtitle
text: *It's looking a little dark in your base, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle063Subtitle
text: *Did someone forget to pay the electric bill?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle064Subtitle
text: *You didn't manage your resources very wisely, did you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle065Subtitle
text: *You are pushing me over-budget, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle066Subtitle
text: *How could this have happened! I had everything planned so perfectly!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle067Subtitle
text: *Do you think I'm scared of your little Scud Storm?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle068Subtitle
text: *That Nuke Silo doesn't frighten me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle069Subtitle
text: *I appreciate your choice in weaponry, but I'm the only one allowed to have a Particle Cannon on this battlefield

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle070Subtitle
text: *Is that as secure as your base can be? Is it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle071Subtitle
text: *That's a lot of tanks, General. Have you seen what a Particle Cannon can do to a lot of tanks?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle072Subtitle
text: *All these planes are just air pollution to me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle073Subtitle
text: *So many troops, General. You weren't actually planning to rush me with them were you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle074Subtitle
text: *That's quite a base you have going there, General. You did remember to space out your buildings to avoid weapon strikes, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle075Subtitle
text: *Do you know how long it's going to take to clean that up?!?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle076Subtitle
text: *Get that disgusting radiation out of my base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle077Subtitle
text: *Hey, that's my Particle Cannon! You're not authorized to use it!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle078Subtitle
